name: Matt Gaetz
subject: Not good (Expulsion)
body:
They are plotting to take me out.
| | [ ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ab654d70e32b418b9ead746bab05c9d0&_e=aS71Eh-EgUA2XxzZWKo1SdmP_2QtjX5bqbPAwlAZDvg_2AhrHaYCnDfzz_fkwHtHCDE7kdOwmqirxGNfAQ7v1F-cU6y87zwZ6BS-B0hcZj-WaMd8ie-sYo75o6Mo4CVtJS94N3Q9iWhs4Y1UAN4yoMoDQMJdLO0It8LshLSt3ajD9U4dF30hkHcTbr3fGTkGuh5veadbzAKBQvcVfiAsdnVmLu9_P97qFj274itIfs44ebhCJGt8FsKIOHt3C4l0C6oUm66R1scYTfmwxqvhs70eiCjtjwSM9w71MVWbLC8%3D)
---
Fellow American, this is not good. Now that House Republicans have removed one of our own members, some RINOs are looking for their next target... _**ME!**_ They hate that I refuse to back down and that I fight for YOU in Washington. Not the DC lobbyists, not the PACs, and not any other special interest groups. They despise that I represent YOU in Congress. The Swamp dwellers don't want anything to change, and they are willing to sell America down the river to protect their own interests. **And since I refuse to play ball with these RINOs, they are secretly plotting behind closed doors and looking for ANYTHING they can use to expel me from Congress.**
| [ ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ab654d70e32b418b9ead746bab05c9d0&_e=aS71Eh-EgUA2XxzZWKo1SdmP_2QtjX5bqbPAwlAZDvg_2AhrHaYCnDfzz_fkwHtHCDE7kdOwmqirxGNfAQ7v1F-cU6y87zwZ6BS-B0hcZj-WaMd8ie-sYo75o6Mo4CVtJS94N3Q9iWhs4Y1UAN4yoF_105jzo6_WdOwnxTb7tmeVPUtiz6WYYtw1e8PD0plJ2o0Ex-8qafyyo0lm6m1fp-FqkrpFdUJuIyXks6Y77iskWNoXZAUTQQeXtGqF5sIcbk-DQmcXr_VshWO0ploPA3yTvvwufeHcohH86YcJ-3U%3D)
---
The only problem with their plan is -**I 'm not going down without a fight.**
I'm not worried about my innocence, I'm concerned about the future of this nation.
That's why I refuse to bend the knee and play nice like they hope I will.
_But I can 't take on the Deep State and their lackeys in the Swamp by myself._
**[I urgently need help fighting back against this sinister plot against me, and I fear that if we fail, there won 't be anyone left in Congress who will stand up to the Swamp.](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ab654d70e32b418b9ead746bab05c9d0&_e=aS71Eh-EgUA2XxzZWKo1SdmP_2QtjX5bqbPAwlAZDvg_2AhrHaYCnDfzz_fkwHtHCDE7kdOwmqirxGNfAQ7v1F-cU6y87zwZ6BS-B0hcZj-WaMd8ie-sYo75o6Mo4CVtJS94N3Q9iWhs4Y1UAN4yoMGrrZFGuNDVim_wvlP8yYwiV6FwlrN5CZSI82wcm7_59QWGes9KVFBUhA1CAlcQGTijcyKJrB-WHydCEOxv8BAzew42txEprg1o0taG59fKm-dxZAVawr_3rPGvq3Q28uL2Mzy-NaBQjFxXPq8CAZ0%3D)**
| [ **DEFEND GAETZ - CHIP IN IMMEDIATELY** ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ab654d70e32b418b9ead746bab05c9d0&_e=aS71Eh-EgUA2XxzZWKo1SdmP_2QtjX5bqbPAwlAZDvg_2AhrHaYCnDfzz_fkwHtHCDE7kdOwmqirxGNfAQ7v1F-cU6y87zwZ6BS-B0hcZj-WaMd8ie-sYo75o6Mo4CVtJS94N3Q9iWhs4Y1UAN4yoMPxKzoS4v7Ab7ouiU4ZhQFS3EfgxbFNeXrinnovc9_w7QqwH810J0aXgEzZehg6Ykc0zvrkMHR2E-XFA6Q86fG0hdNR16diPlgVdmv6YSxf1M9FBsCZQNAXX2HvnjgFA8OHktlY4c-eWKJHppPNH5o%3D)
---
Fellow American, the Deep State, and their RINO allies would love nothing more than to take me out and get their revenge.
**I wouldn 't be surprised if these RINOs chose to waste the precious time we have in Congress to come after me** _instead of doing something about the crisis at our southern border or fighting to impeach Mayorkas and Biden._
But I will do my part and continue to keep their focus on what's ACTUALLY important in our fight to put America First, not their childish vendetta against me.
All I need to know is that folks like you continue to have my back if the time comes and they try to expel me.
**[If you 're with me, Fellow American, I hope you will chip in $10, $20 -- or whatever you can afford -- so I'm ready to take on their radical plot to take me out. ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ab654d70e32b418b9ead746bab05c9d0&_e=aS71Eh-EgUA2XxzZWKo1SdmP_2QtjX5bqbPAwlAZDvg_2AhrHaYCnDfzz_fkwHtHCDE7kdOwmqirxGNfAQ7v1F-cU6y87zwZ6BS-B0hcZj-WaMd8ie-sYo75o6Mo4CVtJS94N3Q9iWhs4Y1UAN4yoESIvvufH3h1TkHeDmXd3V1qvJWlP4qhF67OcEVZKXfvBSEFskfR2s1jpB3RAAW2SUKBYT9J9mVQrU0c-qvRCdOAO_oIXX7tYNxzUY5sLV3qk_ivfxrw8n9C1WeEsd476y1I7pXMReo-M63nk2MfYW8%3D)** Thanks for standing strong, **Matt Gaetz**
| [ ](http://links.fighttheswamp.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ab654d70e32b418b9ead746bab05c9d0&_e=aS71Eh-EgUA2XxzZWKo1SdmP_2QtjX5bqbPAwlAZDvg_2AhrHaYCnDfzz_fkwHtHCDE7kdOwmqirxGNfAQ7v1F-cU6y87zwZ6BS-B0hcZj-WaMd8ie-sYo75o6Mo4CVtJS94N3Q9iWhs4Y1UAN4yoIDo6AyvNBiut38_8-30Cy2aOjAEtAsiD5Sjcl5QIu43Wnyu6kDGQKybic27-WlY1soZrkQxJ_Ym7hgdYqxLDNPtoeLHtedkqWCwxB203C0H1xjbxCEpFJ90MgzT47okXfeEr6I-YXZdDR2eR9YMkHs%3D)

_Jesse traveled to Washington D.C. earlier this year to meet with Montana’s Congressional Delegation (including Sen. Jon Tester, pictured above) regarding resource issues at the USPS._
# Montana's Mail Woes:
# A Challenge to Democracy

In our vast and often brutal Montana landscape, USPS workers frequently brave blizzards and slick October and November roads to deliver election ballots. Too frequently, their most challenging battle is against a lack of resources.
Postal delays are more than an inconvenience; they threaten the accuracy and security of Montana’s elections.
In the early 2010s, rumors of closing the Missoula and Kalispell sorting centers stirred concern among Montanans, rightfully so. Today, as the USPS grapples with hiring troubles and resource shortages, postal employees express similar concerns that further losses will reduce the reliability of our mail system.
Montana’s ballots go out 25 days before Election Day — a timeline that once felt comfortable but now cuts it close. Hand-delivered letters to the local post office often take four or five days to be delivered to P.O. Boxes in that same office.
In a state where elections frequently hinge on a handful of votes, the impact of continued service reductions will be extreme.
Senators Jon Tester and Steve Daines are vocal advocates for protecting Montana’s postal delivery resources, but Representatives Ryan Zinke and Matt Rosendale need to step up. This is a non-partisan issue that can be resolved with the entirety of our congressional delegation actively engaging with the problem.
Reach out to our congressmen and let them know we want accurate elections that allow all legal Montana voters to vote.
Of note, Montanans can track their ballots online using the outdated Secretary of State website — under construction more often than I-90 through Butte — that leaves citizens dealing with dead links and poorly designed interfaces. A recent update aimed for a modern touch, but issues continue.
Montanans deserve better than what they receive from the Post Office, and further reductions will harm more than election integrity. It is appropriate to expect more of our elected officials in order to protect the USPS, a service essential to our democracy.Let’s talk soon!Jesse James Mullen
_This email is a copy of an opinion column written by Jesse that will be published soon in Montana newspapers. It is regarding recent concerns about further reductions to Montana’s USPS resources._

Recently, I received an email from **former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy who is running for the U.S. Senate in Montana**. It moved me so much that I am forwarding it to you today. Please do me a personal favor and take a few minutes to read it - _**it’s compelling.**_

Kellyanne Conway

**From:** Tim Sheehy
**Date:** Thursday, December 7, 2023 at 3:30 PM
**To:** Kellyanne Conway
**Subject:** The day 13 Americans were vaporized in Kabul

Kellyanne,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate this past June.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8638f358cbfd41de929c5c002ad41f08&_e=o-xYRnAI8FpwNNvTENjD_cPkn6N2DnMn_nAyfrr2z9aHu4sHFNwOR_fft2EgT892P9Uu2B0qSmi8eqaM26LNxaH0rMFAk7ivcd5zLHXGkvhyqfyMEQDlaRuneYdCM7dZJMyN42BAt8cc196RaqK2-HAl-c2cn02u46WqqU2leqvENezvk77U2FbnHzNrj3EdrEENi83rePEztR3u6YzfCQbaH_gRs-cwTQZ12eiwt-aOPd7dRbHjWXzZ4VEkDAQiVXTnewUwcrTh7cWE8SdDez1JZD9mP-oblLzZcl1Wdj_VCdH7bdn0cUmZy2UiXUUoc_Fhyaqfz-RPJJendZrpiVxGK_WceBS-fGsjFkne18IWmeOtgVTMwNWYbT6CESbbDKmHkEBZm8s6PuG4AO0L5hB0ZOPH13V9nvYsYHRvsIk%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8638f358cbfd41de929c5c002ad41f08&_e=o-xYRnAI8FpwNNvTENjD_cPkn6N2DnMn_nAyfrr2z9aHu4sHFNwOR_fft2EgT892P9Uu2B0qSmi8eqaM26LNxaH0rMFAk7ivcd5zLHXGkvhyqfyMEQDlaRuneYdCM7dZJMyN42BAt8cc196RaqK2-HAl-c2cn02u46WqqU2leqvENezvk77U2FbnHzNrj3EdrEENi83rePEztR3u6YzfCQbaH_gRs-cwTQZ12eiwt-aOPd7dRbHjWXzZ4VEkDAQiVXTnewUwcrTh7cWE8SdDe6bgZH6jtNOklWZleu8CIpd9A8bQtKZjDH--I0X3zfcNm7Wm-XEnEA8V1epRKN7OpSoDGvDdwYz9qZcWXrfi2Mdw_950mWiS5pnf4I7fR0bDXaoQi2AAcxbTwJkm_QrHenuPim93FToz0bNMKbz3FMQ%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8638f358cbfd41de929c5c002ad41f08&_e=o-xYRnAI8FpwNNvTENjD_cPkn6N2DnMn_nAyfrr2z9aHu4sHFNwOR_fft2EgT892-34KoKjulW6cCTrUXUQoMC0ZzWLItqzL8TBDcamN0UlVWjY2ZqcKa1sg3fKDD4G2cqFEk8-xZnf9pXt-1rXq9XQirpZcm-HVg4nG9WPYSgrxWdAzsZyzUJq62Y6a-ywRZSReBYikXXsLKCLMXT7xL_NsmpDqKT0ZanQQw_ziyx3NMZ0SPd1xhklTrvv4e2hLVb4QgRG85d7HCnL0aS94RCHP2TrwgvZxuZUBvVbv-XGRAYQC_NylDlDgSSgyhhE7HTqJDr1np68xJ8w8ieymedjaYZdbUSJIV8RQk-iTiqj-hnd2SWbJFN2h_R95MuxW1MzUM3QUo2MGKQtG9ALUmmXh_Aexs9Yw-LSzbYz3gTw%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8638f358cbfd41de929c5c002ad41f08&_e=o-xYRnAI8FpwNNvTENjD_cPkn6N2DnMn_nAyfrr2z9aHu4sHFNwOR_fft2EgT892P9Uu2B0qSmi8eqaM26LNxaH0rMFAk7ivcd5zLHXGkvhyqfyMEQDlaRuneYdCM7dZJMyN42BAt8cc196RaqK2-HAl-c2cn02u46WqqU2leqvENezvk77U2FbnHzNrj3EdrEENi83rePEztR3u6YzfCQbaH_gRs-cwTQZ12eiwt-aOPd7dRbHjWXzZ4VEkDAQiVXTnewUwcrTh7cWE8SdDe2uQUCUajNdT-OiTSUA6nROfrayims-Qy8XjC8PJrAQbZnphZjJStH1csvRwDz8oqylOjXucVrUz0NbhuC_aNSvq0byy6SXSPqqLwUmS0pLU8RwVif9MxCJ7sF1EzsCNUTPVkX072iE8LJDAo5kFl-I%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8638f358cbfd41de929c5c002ad41f08&_e=o-xYRnAI8FpwNNvTENjD_cPkn6N2DnMn_nAyfrr2z9aHu4sHFNwOR_fft2EgT892P9Uu2B0qSmi8eqaM26LNxaH0rMFAk7ivcd5zLHXGkvhyqfyMEQDlaRuneYdCM7dZJMyN42BAt8cc196RaqK2-HAl-c2cn02u46WqqU2leqvENezvk77U2FbnHzNrj3EdrEENi83rePEztR3u6YzfCQbaH_gRs-cwTQZ12eiwt-aOPd7dRbHjWXzZ4VEkDAQiVXTnewUwcrTh7cWE8SdDe1l9ey27WHx6RMVrDQbNp-lavTM3RJvTRohSDmxFG8G3t5pHz8i-JYfxCeF3GC7tx4MHRmTm6n-Yz59Sgz-CujvtVn_YuxxkERB60RUi-hXdYYxd1hS07CgJ_0JGlbmFl3JrkF8SFK-COt9X-A89IsI%3D) **

[](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=8638f358cbfd41de929c5c002ad41f08&_e=o-xYRnAI8FpwNNvTENjD_cPkn6N2DnMn_nAyfrr2z9aHu4sHFNwOR_fft2EgT892P9Uu2B0qSmi8eqaM26LNxaH0rMFAk7ivcd5zLHXGkvhyqfyMEQDlaRuneYdCM7dZJMyN42BAt8cc196RaqK2-HAl-c2cn02u46WqqU2leqvENezvk77U2FbnHzNrj3EdrEENi83rePEztR3u6YzfCQbaH_gRs-cwTQZ12eiwt-aOPd7dRbHjWXzZ4VEkDAQiVXTnewUwcrTh7cWE8SdDe_4PK7BTZQmecsy6GeUp82lJvUIWimarjshpj9s4lExUNVoB_NsvAxNa-5gRv1zjxXd5b7KgKJPOmTPiy9OWhP8kzOoJqvPkeE9aIqi0as_uHTb-k3lcNVcQY7hN_GK-pw6l52kq8bGOsTXnlZ1aRM8%3D)

clean_body: Please take a moment to read about this exceptional candidate I’m supporting | | Fellow Conservative, Recently, I received an email from former Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy who is running for the U.S. Senate in Montana. It moved me so much that I am forwarding it to you today. Please do me a personal favor and take a few minutes to read it - it’s compelling. Best Regards, Kellyanne Conway \-------------------------------------------- From: Tim Sheehy Date: Thursday, December 7, 2023 at 3:30 PM To: Kellyanne Conway Subject: The day 13 Americans were vaporized in Kabul Kellyanne, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Kellyanne \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. body:
Derek,

National Republicans confirmed that Mitch
McConnell’s handpicked candidate, Eric Hovde, will run against me in
Wisconsin’s Senate race — and he’ll have their full support.

The GOP has spent months recruiting Eric Hovde, who’ll bring a virtually
unlimited campaign war chest into this race. He has pledged to spend at
least $20 million of his own personal fortune to attack me, buy this seat,
and help Republicans pass their extreme agenda, including a national
abortion ban.

[ https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2209?amount=10&refcode=EM_NBI_TE_20231213_FR_mmfr_0_3MO_TammyBaldwin_TammyBaldwin_NA_mmfr.2.2&t=1001&akid=6519%2E1827488%2Eib8z23 ]Now, the secret’s out — Hovde will run, and I need your support more
than ever to compete with his major cash advantage. Will you split an
emergency donation to help me defeat the GOP’s #1 pick in this race and
defend our Democratic Senate majority?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation
will process immediately and be split between Tony Evers and Tammy Baldwin.

guaranteed to flip red after Sen. Joe Manchin’s retirement, Republicans
only need one more seat to retake the majority, and it could all come down
to what happens here in Wisconsin.

That’s why McConnell made me a top target and Senate Republicans

most pivotal moment of our campaign so far so I’m coming to you for

Thanks for all your support.

#
Peter,
From overturning Roe to banning abortion drugs, Josh Hawley turned his mission to criminalize abortion nationwide into a family business — and he’s abused his power to do it. **Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39989?refcode=em20231213-4383&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4383%2E614464%2EddtewL)
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39989?refcode=em20231213-4383&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4383%2E614464%2EddtewL)**
**IN 2017:** Matt Kacsmaryk was nominated to be a federal judge for the north Texas district court.
His confirmation stalled for years. We learned he even lied to hide just how bizarre his obsession with controlling people’s bodies really is:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/39989?refcode=em20231213-4383&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4383%2E614464%2EddtewL)
**IN 2018:** While his nomination languished in the Senate, Kacsmaryk made an investment in his future.
So he became a campaign donor to Josh Hawley, a fellow member of the Federalist Society — a group of corporate activist lawyers with funders including Chevron, Google, and the Kochs.
**IN 2019:** Now a U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley decided to make Kacsmaryk, his campaign donor, a federal judge.
Hawley confirmed Kacsmaryk to the northern Texas district court — despite bipartisan opposition over Kacsmaryk’s Big Brother views on contraceptives and personal freedoms.

Peter,

I'm writing to you with urgency and outrage about the latest sham from New York's Court of Appeals concerning congressional redistricting.

In what can only be described as a 4-3 mockery of justice, these unelected judges have handed over the redistricting power to the Democrat-controlled state Legislature. This isn't just bad politics; it's an attack on fair elections!

Help me fight back. [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=first+button&utm_campaign=Redistricting+Crime]

They're trying to rig the electoral map, and we won't stand for it. This is electoral manipulation, plain and simple, and a direct attack on every New Yorker's right to fair representation. We're exploring every avenue to fight this. We're not going to let the Democrats steal your voice without a fight. I am fully committed to standing up for democracy, fairness, and integrity, and I know you are too.

## 66th Assembly Central Committee

|

Dear friends and fellow Conservatives,
I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee.
As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member.
While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future.
I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond.
Thank you for your support and dedication to our party.
Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates

# Last Nights Party
**Please read below for our Christmas Outreach**
Last night, the South Bay Republican Assembly gathered for an unforgettable Christmas Party, where the spirit of the season blended with the enthusiasm of like-minded individuals. Festive decorations, spirited conversations, and a shared commitment to values created a joyous atmosphere, allowing attendees to revel in the moment. The event not only showcased the unity and camaraderie within the South Bay Republican Assembly but also marked a memorable celebration that underscored the strength of community and the warmth of the holiday season.
The evening reached its pinnacle with the surprise presentation of two prestigious awards for Republican of the Year. I was honored to receive one of these awards from our own board in the SBCRA, and the other went to an exceptional woman in the South Bay, Janice Webb, the Chair of the 66th Assembly Central Committee. As the room filled with anticipation, the deserving winners were recognized for their outstanding dedication, leadership, and contributions to the principles upheld by the South Bay Republican Assembly. These awards not only celebrated individual accomplishments but also served as a testament to the collective strength and commitment of the assembly's members to making a positive impact in their community.
The Christmas Party was more than just a festive gathering; it was a moment to honor excellence and inspire continued dedication to the Republican values that bind the South Bay community together.
Nena Gates
# Outreach
'Tis that time once more! We're embarking on our Christmas outreach initiative and gearing up to spread joy to those in need. The support from this community has been nothing short of incredible over the past two years, significantly contributing to the success of our outreach efforts. Last year, with your help, we were able to bring smiles to the faces of over 150 needy families through thoughtful gift-giving. This year, my hope is to double that impact.
Here's what we're on the lookout for:
For Kids:
New Clothes, Shoes, and Toys
Toddlers (boys and girls, 2-5 years old)
6-12 years old (boys and girls)
13-18 years old (boys and girls)
For Newborns:
Diapers
New This Year - Young Adults:
Items for young men and women
Example: Shoes, Clothes, Makeup, Cologne, Perfume, Electronics
For Parents:
Gift cards for necessities
Food
Groceries
Gas
Shopping
Your generosity has the power to make a significant difference in the lives of those less fortunate. Let's join forces once again and make this Christmas season even more special for our community. Together, we can extend the spirit of giving and bring warmth to the hearts of many.
Thank you for your continued support and compassion.

## My Husband Derrick Gates is running for Central Committee
---
Dear friends and fellow Conservatives, I am thrilled to announce that I am running for an official seat on the 66th Assembly District Central Committee. As some of you may know, I have been serving as an alternate on the committee for some time now. Over the past two years, I have also been actively involved in multiple posts within the party. I am proud to have been elected to the California Republican Assembly state board of directors as the Senate director for the 24th District, chaired the Faith Outreach committee for the CRA, and served as a delegate for the California State Party. These experiences have given me a deep understanding of the values and principles that are important to our party and have prepared me to effectively represent our district on the central committee. As a member of the central committee, I will work tirelessly to ensure that conservative values remain at the forefront of our party's agenda. I believe that my position on the LAGOP, which is the largest Republican party office in the nation, will allow me to have a greater impact on decisions that affect our party and our community. I have already been able to influence many decisions as an alternate, and I am confident that I can make an even greater impact as an elected member. While some have urged me to run for the congressional seat of the 36th district, I believe that my calling is to bring balance to the party for the next few years. This will not only benefit the party but also other candidates and myself in the long run. Federal races can be expensive to operate, and I have learned from my previous run for Congress that it takes time to build relationships and secure the support needed to win. My goal is to help fix the foundation of the party while building relationships with those who can help me in the future. I am asking for your prayers and support as I take this important step on my journey. Please look for me on the primary ballot on March 5, 2024. Early voting begins on February 24, 2024. Your vote for me, Derrick R. Gates, for the 66th Assembly Central Committee, will help ensure that our conservative values continue to be represented in our district and beyond. Thank you for your support and dedication to our party. Sincerely,
Derrick R. Gates

subject: One Down. Two to go.
body:
Our fight does not stop here.

| Friend, **Last week I confronted the woke university presidents of Harvard, MIT, and Penn for their pathetic moral depravity.** _They REFUSED to give me an answer when I asked them if calls on their campuses for the GENOCIDE of Jews constituted harassment or even a violation of their school's codes of conduct._ The answer should have been a full denunciation of calls to violence on their campuses, and these Left-wing professors have rarely, if ever, defended free speech before. Still, they are TERRIFIED to speak up against the views of the Radical Leftists that have taken hold of their institutions. **I publicly called for these cowards to be fired, and thanks to our supporters, as well as like-minded Americans making our voices heard, Penn President Liz Magill has been forced to resign!** But the fight does not stop here! **The presidents of Harvard and MIT also would not label calls for the genocide of Jews as harassment when I repeatedly pressed them for a direct answer.** We must send a message to the media, the Democratic party, and our nation's woke universities that the American public will not tolerate antisemitism and all calls to violence by left-wing agitators. **Ensuring all 3 of these university presidents are removed is the next step in sending that message.** _**Sign here to demand the immediate resignations of Harvard President Claudine Gay and MIT President Sally Kornbluth:**_

name: Terry Schilling, American Principles Project
subject: Who’s protecting our children?
body:
It’s time for us to take our country back

---
| | | | | | | | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zin3sk123o94ujvuq9h16deu9ein4gf6fg5qu188_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clim8or4cjh2bs)
---
| Friend,
**7-Eleven. McDonald’s. The Balloon Council. Even something called the “U.S. Association of Reptile Keepers!”**
What do they all have in common? Lobbyists fight for them in D.C.!
Do you know what _doesn’t_ have lobbyists fighting for it? **The American Family.**
And it shows.
Our Left-wing government proves time and again that not only are they _unwilling_ to fight for the American family - **they hate the American family,** especially children.
How else do you explain what’s happening in American schools:

* Elementary schools **brainwashing** kids about transgenderism and dangerous gender-reassignment surgery

* High schools **forcing** girls to tolerate boys in their bathrooms

* Colleges **demanding** women to compete against biological men in sports

Woke Leftists don’t care. In fact, Congresswomen like AOC want _even more_ extremism shoved down our children’s throats.
Our kids are our future and **no one is protecting them.** No one is stopping this violence.
**That’s why we founded American Principles Project.**
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zmcbt2v3mruopukg64mhe22804p8u5vgahvuh3j8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clim8or4cjh2bs)
American Principles Project is the _only_ nonprofit 100% dedicated to protecting kids and the American nuclear family. We’re grassroots. We’re nationwide. **And we fight Extremist legislation wherever and whenever we see it.**
Our work speaks for itself:

* **21 states BANNED sex-change surgeries on kids.**

* **23 states BANNED biological men from unfairly dominating in women’s sports.**

* We helped pass the **Parents Bill of Rights Act,** forcing schools to be transparent, ensuring parents know ALL information about their child’s **education** and **safety.**

These are some American Principles Project wins in defense of families nationwide. **But the threats are rising. There is still SO MUCH MORE to do.**
We need **_You._**
I can’t stress it enough - our work at American Principles Project is impossible without your help. **We know you are just as passionate and fed-up as we are.**
The 2024 election is looming. The time is now. Let’s band together and protect those who need it most.
No one will do it for us!

body:
It’s time for us to take our country back

---
| | | | | | | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2ztu000dq2ppfnqr4o1aem09qtr2bveoaubvtibm0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32climaoj4s5h2bs)
---
| Friend,
**7-Eleven. McDonald’s. The Balloon Council. Even something called the “U.S. Association of Reptile Keepers!”**
What do they all have in common? Lobbyists fight for them in D.C.!
Do you know what _doesn’t_ have lobbyists fighting for it? **The American Family.**
And it shows.
Our Left-wing government proves time and again that not only are they _unwilling_ to fight for the American family - **they hate the American family,** especially children.
How else do you explain what’s happening in American schools:

* Elementary schools **brainwashing** kids about transgenderism and dangerous gender-reassignment surgery

* High schools **forcing** girls to tolerate boys in their bathrooms

* Colleges **demanding** women to compete against biological men in sports

Woke Leftists don’t care. In fact, Congresswomen like AOC want _even more_ extremism shoved down our children’s throats.
Our kids are our future and **no one is protecting them.** No one is stopping this violence.
**That’s why we founded American Principles Project.**
[](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2za00th4ie29lriis8j7ls1o3g7s4fgvd5q6lqg00_rp22sh2s8i6eo32climaoj4s5h2bs)
American Principles Project is the _only_ nonprofit 100% dedicated to protecting kids and the American nuclear family. We’re grassroots. We’re nationwide. **And we fight Extremist legislation wherever and whenever we see it.**
Our work speaks for itself:

* **21 states BANNED sex-change surgeries on kids.**

* **23 states BANNED biological men from unfairly dominating in women’s sports.**

* We helped pass the **Parents Bill of Rights Act,** forcing schools to be transparent, ensuring parents know ALL information about their child’s **education** and **safety.**

These are some American Principles Project wins in defense of families nationwide. **But the threats are rising. There is still SO MUCH MORE to do.**
We need **_You._**
I can’t stress it enough - our work at American Principles Project is impossible without your help. **We know you are just as passionate and fed-up as we are.**
The 2024 election is looming. The time is now. Let’s band together and protect those who need it most.
No one will do it for us!

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

# Foreign Policy? What Foreign Policy?
By Rex Weddle, Volunteer, Robertson for Congress
---
Over three years in office, Democrats have created nothing but chaos with U.S. foreign policy. Look at the world scene. Is it better or worse since a feckless Biden took over? Dina Titus supports all of his failed policies, such as:
* Afghanistan: Upon assuming office, Biden instantly "withdrew" from Afghanistan, with all the finesse and strategic planning of a delinquent tenant fleeing a landlord in the middle of the night, except with tragic results.
* Ukraine: Russia, encouraged by our Afghan folly, quickly ignored international law. Using a page out of Nazi Germany's playbook, it invaded a sovereign Ukraine with impunity and gave the West a festering war, now going on for two years.
* Israel and the Middle East: Biden and his Congressional minions resurrected Obama's Middle East "leading from behind" foreign policy, which proved disastrous at every turn ten years ago. As soon as Joe got in, he withdrew Iran's sanctions and gave billions in aid and concessions to it and other sworn Middle East enemy countries. Result? That money financed a war of brutal terrorism against Israel.
* China: After Joe and his wayward son made friends with China, its threats against Taiwan escalated. China has infiltrated our universities and businesses, stealing trade secrets and intellectual property. Unchecked, China is the source of Mexican cartels' fentanyl distribution in our country.
* National Security: Biden ensured our military branches are more concerned with woke conduct and their use of "correct" pronouns than first-class defense. His catastrophic open border policy helps undermine our economy and puts all Americans at risk.

Mark Robertson's International Credentials

* Active military duty in 10 foreign countries, including NATO assignments and combat tours in Afghanistan, Iraq, and Kuwait
* Policy-making positions in the Pentagon
* Faculty member of the National Defense University
* U.S. delegate to the Global Coalition against ISIS
* Leader in Joint International Military Exercises around the world

You must ask yourself: Is US foreign policy stronger or weaker than three years ago? Our enemies must fear us! We need Mark and people like him to restore our credibility. The times demand it.

Mark Robertson answers your questions with direct and honest answers. Here are two questions Mark was asked recently:
Q: Mark, what is your position on the war in Israel? -Q.P. A. I fully support Israel's right to defend itself and to eliminate terrorists' ability to threaten and attack Israelis. The events of October 7th revealed to the world the evil nature of Hamas. The Palestinians living in Gaza should take immediate action to remove this terrorist cancer that has burrowed itself beneath their communities. Freedom-loving Palestinians should assist the Israeli Defense Forces by pointing out the locations of the hidden terrorists. I feel compassion for the children in Gaza. It is time for their parents to stand up to Hamas, which has brought so much pain and sorrow to their family and community. As your Representative in Congress, I will support Israel and all of our allies in their fight for freedom, family, and prosperity.

Please share this message with friends and neighbors. Have questions for me? Simply reply to this email to ask me a question.

|
Friends,

It's well known that Democrat State Sen. Marko Liias is currently taking in the sights in Helsinki on a "traffic safety" learning junket. So, we couldn't resist updating you on his sightseeing using our tax dollars - because, evidently, he couldn't, either.

Sen. Liias is so tone deaf he has been updating his followers on Twitter/X about everything he is learning about "traffic safety" over in Finland. And given the expense of the trip, one would assume that the Fins must have some groundbreaking policy insights to share that he could not possibly have obtained via Zoom call.

Alas, readers are severely disappointed. Laughably, Liias has shared he has "learned" from Finland that you can reduce traffic fatalities by lowering wintertime speed limits. What a revelation! And they cracked down on drunk driving - astonishing!

Of course, we couldn't resist chiming in to remind him that one doesn't need to travel across the world at taxpayers' expense to figure out that slower driving in winter equals fewer accidents.

Along with pointing out the absurdity of Sen. Liias' trip, we here at Shift WA remain committed to trying to get answers to the pressing questions that Liias refuses to answer and the media refuses to ask. These include: How much does this Finnish winter holiday cost? Who is generously footing the bill? And who, oh who, is lucky enough to join him on this expensive jaunt?

Of course, the mainstream media remains tight-lipped about Liias' jet-setting adventure - even though he is calling some out by name in his tweets - and the hypocrisy of him leaving a massive carbon footprint in his wake. They refuse to do their jobs and ask tough questions that hold Democrats accountable.

That's why our work here at Shift WA is so important. We need your help to continue our crucial work of asking the questions that mainstream media outlets refuse to even acknowledge. Warnings of physical, electro-magnetic pulse (EMP) and cyberattacks... And who suffers because of their neglect? It's a real threat. **That's why many Americans are taking matters into their own hands and are securing their own solar powered generator.** Solar generators are a smart choice because they produce an endless supply of life-saving electricity when you need it most - and **without gas, fumes or noise**. Our top recommendation in portable solar generators is the [**Patriot Power Generator**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37897%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=GEMRIf8Mej54vOqFxcP0pQ&sysid=1). **THIS breakthrough solar generator is safe enough to use inside. And never needs gas, ever.** And you'll have peace of mind knowing that you and your family have a safe, reliable and easy-to-use source of backup power. To survive a blackout, storm, grid-down event... or worse. It's why the Patriot Power Generator was recently featured on **Fox & Friends**... **And why over 107,000 Americans already have it in their homes right now.** **Demand is surging...** _"It has a battery inside. You can charge it with electricity or - what's really cool - with a solar panel that comes with it for FREE."_ [**Click Here To See This Breakthrough Solar Generation In Action**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c37898%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=AgKL9f4RDrmrJV90TVVX%2bg&sysid=1)

body:
It’s time for us to take our country back

---
| | | | | | | | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2znjc65n8822cc1o6v9695r1270grcer0c8ee4hi0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clhm6o36cph2bs)
---
| Friend,
**7-Eleven. McDonald’s. The Balloon Council. Even something called the “U.S. Association of Reptile Keepers!”**
What do they all have in common? Lobbyists fight for them in D.C.!
Do you know what _doesn’t_ have lobbyists fighting for it? **The American Family.**
And it shows.
Our Left-wing government proves time and again that not only are they _unwilling_ to fight for the American family - **they hate the American family,** especially children.
How else do you explain what’s happening in American schools:

* Elementary schools **brainwashing** kids about transgenderism and dangerous gender-reassignment surgery

* High schools **forcing** girls to tolerate boys in their bathrooms

* Colleges **demanding** women to compete against biological men in sports

Woke Leftists don’t care. In fact, Congresswomen like AOC want _even more_ extremism shoved down our children’s throats.
Our kids are our future and **no one is protecting them.** No one is stopping this violence.
**That’s why we founded American Principles Project.**
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z95tiii01netiqfisu750vojse09678nc6c4s8c8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clhm6o36cph2bs)
American Principles Project is the _only_ nonprofit 100% dedicated to protecting kids and the American nuclear family. We’re grassroots. We’re nationwide. **And we fight Extremist legislation wherever and whenever we see it.**
Our work speaks for itself:

* **21 states BANNED sex-change surgeries on kids.**

* **23 states BANNED biological men from unfairly dominating in women’s sports.**

* We helped pass the **Parents Bill of Rights Act,** forcing schools to be transparent, ensuring parents know ALL information about their child’s **education** and **safety.**

These are some American Principles Project wins in defense of families nationwide. **But the threats are rising. There is still SO MUCH MORE to do.**
We need **_You._**
I can’t stress it enough - our work at American Principles Project is impossible without your help. **We know you are just as passionate and fed-up as we are.**
The 2024 election is looming. The time is now. Let’s band together and protect those who need it most.
No one will do it for us!
**[Join us, and defend the nation’s most precious asset. Even just $15 dollars would be an invaluable contribution. Nothing is more important than family.**](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zbdbc0og004ilrki2rhvq14ts2plcs5d7sqtulho_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clhm6o36cph2bs)

| | **Dear Friend,** | **Time is running out to save our oceans, marine life, and the communities that rely on them. Donate $27 today.** _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196073?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

---
I didn’t want to send this email, but this is serious. Last year, almost **ONE-SIXTH of Florida’s manatee population was DECIMATED by starvation and pollution.** **And this year isn’t looking any better for these gentle giants.**
These gentle creatures are _painfully withering away_ without enough food to eat. They’re _sucking in toxins_ as cruise ships recklessly dump waste into the ocean: waste that makes food even harder for manatees to find -- and waste that impacts coastal communities, too. **[Big Cruise can’t keep chasing profit at the expense of our only Earth and everything that lives on it. Help stop this greedy industry and rush your $27 contribution to help us reach our $5,300 goal to protect our planet, marine life, and people before it’s too late!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196077?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
2023 is on track to be another deadly year for manatees, with **over 400 helpless manatees having already perished since January.** And mega-polluting industries like Big Cruise play a significant role in this tragedy. Cruise ships dump filthy, contaminated wastewater directly into fragile ocean habitats that are critical for vulnerable species! This harmful pollution feeds destructive algae blooms that kill manatees' primary food source, seagrass. So, it’s no surprise that manatees are dying rapidly from starvation -- all of which is _completely avoidable._
These needless deaths are affecting people, too. Marine life is washing up on the shore, **emaciated and filled with toxins from cruise ships.** And fisheries and tourism are suffering as a result. This pattern can’t continue.
That’s why I’m reaching out to you today. **We MUST hold cruise companies and other Big Polluters accountable for the damage they cause before we run out of time to make a difference. And I know you recognize how high the stakes are. Will you stand with us today to protect our oceans, wildlife, and communities before Big Cruise causes irreversible damage to our planet?**
[](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196078?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
**Big Cruise can’t get away with its destruction anymore. Donate $27 today to take a stand and help protect oceans, communities, and our planet.**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196073?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196074?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196075?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196076?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Right now, the powerful cruise industry is BOOMING. Ships the size of city blocks are speeding through coastal waters and spewing their endless pollution. The industry has grown so fast that governments have struggled to regulate it. Greedy cruise companies have taken advantage of this situation, going beyond the huge quantities of LEGAL pollution to __illegal dumping.__
But the harm cruise ships cause doesn’t just end with their reckless dumping of harmful contaminants. These mammoth vessels are powered by some of the _**dirtiest heavy fuel.**_ And believe it or not, cruise ships **never** stop running -- even when they dock! **Every day, a mid-sized cruise ship emits as much particulate pollution as ONE MILLION CARS.** People in coastal communities are trapped, breathing in this harmful pollution, and suffering higher rates of respiratory diseases as a result.
And it gets worse, Friend. Some companies have _SUED_ to block coastal communities from exercising their fundamental rights and protecting themselves from emissions-induced diseases! **No company should be able to take away our right to fight for our health and the health of our neighbors. For the sake of our oceans, people, and our planet, we MUST fight back.**
**Big Industry is endangering our planet and our health. Fight back now and donate $27 toward our $5,300 goal to help protect people, marine life, and the planet!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196073?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196074?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196075?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/2196076?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
We’re at a tipping point, Friend. Big Cruise has massive resources that give it the upper hand. If we don’t change the narrative soon, we could reach a point of no return when it comes to the health of our planet.
It's not going to be easy to take on the powerful cruise industry -- but we can't just sit back and let Big Cruise's toxic air and wastewater emissions cause severe harm to animals, people, and the planet. Without action, Big Cruise companies like Carnival Corp. will continue to **recklessly dump toxic wastewater into our ocean waters. And we could see the degradation of our ocean ecosystems -- one of the few tools we have to slow down some of the impacts of climate change.**
Friends of the Earth is standing up against the greedy cruise industry that prioritizes profits over human lives, helpless wildlife, and the health of our planet. We are working to make sure proper regulations exist and are enforced for massive cruise ships. That means pushing the EPA to do the right thing and put its foot down against cruise pollution. **But we can’t win this fight without your help. We’re a grassroots organization -- and we rely on support from people like you, who understand how high the stakes are right now.**
Your membership support today will go a long way towards standing up against Big Polluters and fighting for a healthy and just planet. We’ve set an ambitious goal of $5,300 today to fuel this work -- but we’re falling short. If just 4 more activists from your area contribute now, we can still reach our goal to stand up for vulnerable species and the planet. Will you donate $27 today and join us in this fight?
**Donate $27 today and help Friends of the Earth hold corporate polluters accountable and protect our oceans, our people, and the only Earth we’ll ever get!**

## Supreme Court to Review Key Jan. 6 Charges
The Supreme Court has agreed to review a case that could [derail hundreds of Jan. 6](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPhCAUhH-Ndhh5IGpBcY3dXnuleeJjZYNCANe7f3_x6msmk0wyM_m-HvMDnXfH8xN30sWGGU1xb5o5MC4ZiFnWq7ZEQKImzfsWOgXjqOpNC6Vkp4xVgx2WHhBUZxaUXAxiHfhia6ehBcGBS952HcgGR2pB9qNU69Cu0FeypdWVkJpXcEfZyPqf8KbUmLDXXm-lxFyJjwqmCqbruhr8diHfaQXT3V3BxOGW2-UzJtqJmXCmwko698heeDDFwpJLOk1x4WAYI6FnBjPVSa_xct67rO4vzx2d_9su_6P4DQAA__8jM152) felony prosecutions and impact the criminal charges against Donald Trump. At issue is an appeal by a Jan. 6 defendant who claims the charge of "obstruction of an official proceeding," based on an Enron-era law designed to punish [the shredding of documents](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsUD2vnTAM_TWwGSUmgcvA0IXtdu2IQjDgNhAUzI36759481ssH-nofP15j2_HgY_1t9uplyWOzgt_aNQI2gDWoynnfiFCqkvqdavQNth1Tbn1ymDjJv9aZvNStnGeJtu5hXyLnbG2KblHhbVGbbSyFk3lOlJo2s4080vN2BZG0cwSU_U38iEbLeF__FCqfNzL0G8i51XUvwocChxyztUZAwv7-BAKHA7KV4HD41LgoPE5z3fdZ6KdwMc7CWQOARJ9mDJcPp4EcYE4XZJuLxwPCC6DbE5A0r2fwBf4zaWVjxUyywZTIvfvQUrpWlttytTP5yPLV_OUWHfH4Tu0_LzhVwAAAP__bQJzBg), shouldn't be used against the Jan. 6 defendants. The government says the law covers any kind of obstruction and not just physical tampering of documents. It carries a penalty of up to 20 years in jail and has been used in most of the Jan. 6 prosecutions. It's also one of the charges against Trump.

Hunter Biden refused to sit for a deposition in Congress on Wednesday, instead holding a press conference at the Capitol that raised [questions about President Biden's](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHSoyAUxfGn0Q4HLoixoNjGLttu6RC4yM0gZITo5u13svVXn1P85v_nvt4tJcrbb7ujaaGs1jU6cRXAhGIgV9V7ExABZY9GTBxGDfOs-2jEqHHSwo1cCC9ndwshgFBSaBluE-ieDHCQAoQSfBxBDXZGDmqalfY37mHqFEdPrRzDs1BuEUP6lBOPwZW9Tya29qqd_NXB0sFyXdcQyt-MV_3uHSyvkqiRqx0sz3J4m1m1n8riOzc82IM8ZrZbjyy-N2Qu2rzh90J5Y5EqC7ZFPFigbLMjm9KHUT5LOtGzx7tSxlr7w_jXRSlR1V_vtltK_33t51z_AgAA___izm7L) previous statements about his involvement in Hunter's business. **7-Eleven. McDonald’s. The Balloon Council. Even something called the “U.S. Association of Reptile Keepers!”**
What do they all have in common? Lobbyists fight for them in D.C.!
Do you know what _doesn’t_ have lobbyists fighting for it? **The American Family.**
And it shows.
Our Left-wing government proves time and again that not only are they _unwilling_ to fight for the American family - **they hate the American family,** especially children.

We need **_You._**

track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record

politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the
legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his

stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next
President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill
for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for

decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for
another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act
is now.

Dear Peter,
Can I win?
I’m asked this every day!
And the answer, according to the _Fair Observer_ , is "Of Course".
Columnist Scott Bennett is looking at the same numbers we are, and has concluded, based on the national poll data, that, **yes, “Robert F. Kennedy Jr. can win.”**
I couldn’t agree more. As I meet with hundreds of people every day across this country, the excitement for new leadership is palpable!

body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d256f765f064e718702f7ec448db313&_e=VR09rt74z8seswpCOTVHUacxFos427hWEfnc8xpTjgxCKdU0kpGen2L5etTA6MXaFR4RfCs4s0c-iwVbxket4VuMNBrsX-vswF8fNZ0zICxCsmC6DXpQFqK-3OTBknbSwxzGb_Z0tum62_r1uLxwHPX3us8iN2XJhP0vKABYiUwGbZImATu3XiwYZnL6-Mksxp-aTPhijcZHKLB5NjgifXw0RC_fJnJBt0wv3o-res-dr7HjHd2B22OEDdfpLvUtoD9lQdOX6W2DceFsQN61LQHO-nwWE5o0o1H6A2tS_A48S62sMeIHFVVxlZa-6shcObpG_bIFrGqH7NQxVzwOfoQPn7Y1Xj_99FHoHMshQjHvBkw-jMm-Bb9A7dTqn-spoYnsDitfw4YSAe306vxqyg%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d256f765f064e718702f7ec448db313&_e=VR09rt74z8seswpCOTVHUacxFos427hWEfnc8xpTjgxCKdU0kpGen2L5etTA6MXaFR4RfCs4s0c-iwVbxket4VuMNBrsX-vswF8fNZ0zICxCsmC6DXpQFqK-3OTBknbSwxzGb_Z0tum62_r1uLxwHPX3us8iN2XJhP0vKABYiUwGbZImATu3XiwYZnL6-Mksxp-aTPhijcZHKLB5NjgifXw0RC_fJnJBt0wv3o-res-hxOz_wH8q43n17YFI90gdJVr_k9AIxqhsIyIXT6mxc_3vUyq1jx2OSFlkAmm1hHMbv0gwNRQyUL9gP3Gc9q3Ft3EGXjYkGHmQhigaWeyuJN1xLSJi7u27nYszLJ8sBKrolPU9bvkJxUhsee7AP1fsJd7oR5unxAB47JmTKd_p3A%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2d256f765f064e718702f7ec448db313&_e=VR09rt74z8seswpCOTVHUacxFos427hWEfnc8xpTjgxCKdU0kpGen2L5etTA6MXaFR4RfCs4s0c-iwVbxket4VuMNBrsX-vswF8fNZ0zICxCsmC6DXpQFqK-3OTBknbSwxzGb_Z0tum62_r1uLxwHPX3us8iN2XJhP0vKABYiUwGbZImATu3XiwYZnL6-Mksxp-aTPhijcZHKLB5NjgifXw0RC_fJnJBt0wv3o-res9ucFAUgr3Ob11cLCR6xjjWxWt_6fZhkFq3wUUKKtOxEq8ZYR_-xPGc0YDeUE-jL6z1TxYMwYgVCcewaxW-1_Wu4fq6695lgiAfel5o2aLupD2XSDPkqeTqv1UEGpeV6raemB5v7gTQj8wpGxVLDn0qoyn36oMtF1VzRId43su-nQ%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

subject: The thing about underdogs…
body:
Every race I run, I run to win – even when the odds are stacked against me.

| |
---
| | | | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh4m53n3hr9eqsndojv3g4tvc9434qctns7ia14g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cljm6o74c5h2bs)
---

Friend,

I've been the underdog in every race I've run.
---
| | | I was an outsider when I ran for South Carolina's state legislature against a 30-year incumbent. A week before the primary, I was polling at 15 percent
---
| | [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3jpn8329u51qeikjrcl9kiokbvgqj5jqs92hv2g_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cljm6o74c5h2bs)
---
When I ran for governor, I was the least funded, and the least known GOP candidate in the race. _A few months before Election Day, I was polling in fourth place. _

I've been the underdog each time -- and I've never lost an election.

**[Here's the thing about underdogs-- people underestimate us, we put 1,000% into everything, we take nothing for granted, and we appreciate every single gain we make.](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zsbl7a8314k33stalqblabue22fgmquejhvbiie0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32cljm6o74c5h2bs "Here's the thing about underdogs — people underestimate us, we put 1,000% into everything, we take nothing for granted, and we appreciate every single gain we make.")**

name: American Briefing
subject: We are in the midst of a great crisis
body:
You understand that the anti-American Left is working every day to undermine intelligent patriotism and radically transform our free system of government and our American way of life.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv2j7g4578uvsllstu67uhuov95qjf9au5djmmj0_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge0oj4cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

I am writing to you today because we are in the midst of a great crisis. And fortunately, you understand this ...

You understand that the anti-American Left is working every day to undermine intelligent patriotism and radically transform our free system of government and our American way of life.

You understand the urgency of the situation as we approach 2024--a **critical year** for America...

We must engage the anti-American Left on the battlefield of education to defend liberty and constitutional government.

Hillsdale College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades.

**Your generosity helps us to counter an anti-American education agenda that includes promoting radical gender ideology to young schoolchildren and encouraging college students to celebrate terrorism.**

That's why we're asking for your year-end support to continue and expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

**We must do more.**

With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale's educational mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this critical time for our nation.

That's why we've set a goal to raise $6,000,000 online by December 31 to expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** in 2024.

Your generous donation will help us to ...

* **Reach an additional 600,000 American households and businesses with _Imprimis_ , our monthly digest of liberty.** With your support, we plan to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to more than 7,000,000 households and businesses in 2024.
* **Teach citizens nationwide, especially younger Americans, through our FREE online courses.** Your donation will help us to create new online courses and add 900,000 new students in 2024.
* **Restore excellence to American K-12 education.** Your faithful generosity will help us to launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

We cannot do this work without you ...

Hillsdale needs your support for its work on behalf of liberty because the forces arrayed against it on the battleground of education are many and powerful.

They are also incredibly well-funded, with Hollywood, Big Tech, mega-corporations, and liberal billionaires like George Soros on their side.

Hillsdale College relies on the support of citizens like you--citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty and want their children and grandchildren to enjoy the blessings of liberty and the American way of life.

**To do our work on behalf of liberty, we need your help.
**
As I've explained in the past, Hillsdale College **conducts its educational outreach efforts** --as it does all of its work--while refusing to accept **one penny** of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

To meet our ambitious year-end funding goal, we will need thousands of gifts between **$25** and **$100**. Most of our supporters' contributions are in this range.

We will also need a significant number of **$500** to **$1,000** donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

Since we have less than a month remaining to fund this project for 2024, we urgently need your help.

**You can safely and securely renew your support using this link:[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye-2023](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zv5g04pq9pqfp0j5tno268konhoi31q67oiua838_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge0oj4cph2bs)**

In the coming year, the anti-American Left will pull out all the stops to keep its stranglehold on government and on education alike.

It will continue in its efforts to undermine intelligent patriotism in our schools and to radically transform our free system of government.

It is not an exaggeration to say that the future of American liberty hangs in the balance.

That's why I hope you'll make your most generous year-end gift before the December 31 deadline.

Every dollar you give will get us closer to our **$6,000,000** online fundraising goal, enabling us to expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** in 2024.

Thank you for your generosity. We are grateful for friends like you who understand what is at stake at this critical time for our nation.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

---

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=913%2E135344%2EinCPDw)

Friend -
A LOT has happened recently in the Michigan Senate race. So to keep you up to date, we wanted to lay out the biggest updates. So, let’s review the bidding, shall we?
Right now, there are 10 Republicans in the Michigan Senate primary, of which four are serious competitors: former Congressman Mike Rogers, former Detroit Police Chief James Craig, former Congressman Peter Meijer, and, most recently, former Senate candidate and businessman Sandy Pensler. (One additional candidate gets props for [**putting out a song last week**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/1761?t=2&akid=913%2E135344%2EinCPDw) for her supporters).
**No matter how they spin it, each of these candidates have demonstrated a clear desire to play to the extreme of the Republican party to win this crowded primary. Even at the expense of their own dignity.**
Take Mike Rogers for example: despite trying to paint himself as a moderate, his voting record in Congress tells an opposite story. He supports abortion bans even in the cases of rape, incest, and common miscarriage, and he has advocated to privatize Social Security. And in September as a signal to the far-right, he produced a video attacking the FBI for going after Trump, even though he worked for the FBI for years, and ran for Congress on his FBI credentials!
And then we have James Craig, a Republican former Detroit Police Chief competing to be the most Trump-aligned potential candidate. He is against any additional gun safety laws, he opposes all abortion, including for victims of rape and incest, and denied the results of the 2020 election. Instead of spending his campaign out in the community, we’ve seen him go on Steve Bannon’s podcast in the clear hope of currying Trump’s endorsement.
Then there’s former Congressman Peter Meijer – who was one of 10 Republican members of Congress who voted to impeach Donald Trump after the January 6th insurrection. He has done a complete 180, claiming he now would support Trump’s nomination for President. In a further show of his extremism, he has said publicly that he supports a federal ban on abortion and has campaigned on being “100% pro-life” – even in cases of rape or incest.
He has also stood against workers by vocally supporting right-to-work and other anti-union legislation. And instead of sticking to a principled approach with Trump – whom he voted to impeach after the January 6th insurrection – he has instead decided to flip-flop, claiming he would support Trump's nomination and that he didn’t think Trump incited an insurrection.
Finally, there’s Sandy Pensler, who spent over $5 million of his own money in the Senate race in 2018. He lost the Republican nomination to John James (earning 46% of the vote). He supported the 2017 Trump tax giveaway, cutting taxes for the ultra wealthy like himself, and has staked out an extreme position on abortion: he says he is “a pro-life conservative”; called Roe v. Wade a “terrible decision,” and claimed that Prop 3 in Michigan, which protected the right to choose, “went too far.”
**The bottom line? These candidates are bad news for Michiganders – and it’s our goal to elect someone level-headed and responsible with a proven track record like Elissa to combat the chaos of the Republican party.**
But what does all of this mean for our campaign? While Republicans sort through their messy primary and try to appeal to the extreme wing of their party, we need to share our positive message about Elissa with voters across Michigan. That's the best way to combat the negative attacks we'll face from Republicans – but it's going to take resources.
[**If everyone reading this email contributed just $10, we’d be able to continue building the early foundation we need to ensure success in 2024 ahead of our final FEC deadline of the year on December 31st. The most important thing is that you show you're on Team Slotkin today. Can you contribute $10 to help Elissa win this competitive open Senate seat in Michigan?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231214-1-tt&t=3&akid=913%2E135344%2EinCPDw)
