name: American Briefing
subject: We are in the midst of a great crisis
body:
You understand that the anti-American Left is working every day to undermine intelligent patriotism and radically transform our free system of government and our American way of life.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z990p1an8tt0gbg84jftrq92cdsugcucj7ucj46o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge0ob4cth2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend,

I am writing to you today because we are in the midst of a great crisis. And fortunately, you understand this ...

You understand that the anti-American Left is working every day to undermine intelligent patriotism and radically transform our free system of government and our American way of life.

You understand the urgency of the situation as we approach 2024--a **critical year** for America...

We must engage the anti-American Left on the battlefield of education to defend liberty and constitutional government.

Hillsdale College has been deeply engaged in this battle for decades.

**Your generosity helps us to counter an anti-American education agenda that includes promoting radical gender ideology to young schoolchildren and encouraging college students to celebrate terrorism.**

That's why we're asking for your year-end support to continue and expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

**We must do more.**

With the help of friends like you, who support Hillsdale's educational mission, we are determined to redouble our efforts at this critical time for our nation.

That's why we've set a goal to raise $6,000,000 online by December 31 to expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** in 2024.

Your generous donation will help us to ...

* **Reach an additional 600,000 American households and businesses with _Imprimis_ , our monthly digest of liberty.** With your support, we plan to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to more than 7,000,000 households and businesses in 2024.
* **Teach citizens nationwide, especially younger Americans, through our FREE online courses.** Your donation will help us to create new online courses and add 900,000 new students in 2024.
* **Restore excellence to American K-12 education.** Your faithful generosity will help us to launch and guide classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

We cannot do this work without you ...

Hillsdale needs your support for its work on behalf of liberty because the forces arrayed against it on the battleground of education are many and powerful.

They are also incredibly well-funded, with Hollywood, Big Tech, mega-corporations, and liberal billionaires like George Soros on their side.

Hillsdale College relies on the support of citizens like you--citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty and want their children and grandchildren to enjoy the blessings of liberty and the American way of life.

**To do our work on behalf of liberty, we need your help.
**
As I've explained in the past, Hillsdale College **conducts its educational outreach efforts** --as it does all of its work--while refusing to accept **one penny** of government funding, not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

To meet our ambitious year-end funding goal, we will need thousands of gifts between **$25** and **$100**. Most of our supporters' contributions are in this range.

We will also need a significant number of **$500** to **$1,000** donations. But contributions of any size are appreciated.

Since we have less than a month remaining to fund this project for 2024, we urgently need your help.

**You can safely and securely renew your support using this link:[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/cye-2023](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zvpjjjabefbbigk5tlqmiccrbvop647bs23gmo0o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge0ob4cth2bs)**

In the coming year, the anti-American Left will pull out all the stops to keep its stranglehold on government and on education alike.

It will continue in its efforts to undermine intelligent patriotism in our schools and to radically transform our free system of government.

It is not an exaggeration to say that the future of American liberty hangs in the balance.

That's why I hope you'll make your most generous year-end gift before the December 31 deadline.

Every dollar you give will get us closer to our **$6,000,000** online fundraising goal, enabling us to expand our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** in 2024.

Thank you for your generosity. We are grateful for friends like you who understand what is at stake at this critical time for our nation.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

11 years ago, a gunman killed 26 people in Sandy Hook elementary, most of them 6 and 7-year-olds. Sandy Hook should have mobilized Congress to take radical action to prevent further carnage and death. Instead, it wasn't until nearly a decade later after another school shooting – this time at Robb Elementary in Uvalde, Texas – that we got any federal action to staunch the crisis of gun violence in our country. Unfortunately, it hasn’t stopped the violence. On Wednesday last week, three people were killed in a mass shooting at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas. **On that same day, congressional Republicans blocked a bill to renew the assault weapons ban.** Earlier this summer, my opponent – Brian Fitzpatrick – single handedly blocked an assault weapons ban and universal background checks in the House. subject: Bring my husband home before Christmas
body:
Tears are streaming down my face as I write this e-mail. And when I tell you what’s happened, you’ll understand why I’m heartbroken...

| |
---
| | Dear Friend,Tears are streaming down my face as I write this e-mail. And when I tell you what’s happened, you’ll understand why I’m heartbroken... ...and I pray you’ll take 30 seconds out of your day right now to give me a glimmer of hope by signing this **[Emergency Pardon Petition](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztv70is85108hhpil7eesc8kbkqkavilrthgl9r8_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge4oj2cjh2bs) **to bring my husband home before Christmas. The Missouri Courts just upheld the unjust manslaughter conviction against my husband, decorated Kansas City Police Detective Eric DeValkenaere.You see, my husband is a victim of the radical anti-police movement sweeping our nation.And he just lost what we believed was a slam-dunk appeal. Although the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won
---
| | Now Eric sits in a jail cell for a crime he did not commit – locked away from our 3 children and me – unless Missouri Governor Mike Parson pardons him.**[That’s why I’m asking you to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztdscf3mah4725u3o6l42m2g85771gs16l46jlqo_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge4oj2cjh2bs)** Please let me explain...On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets.
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zck5m7abqf4o7i2fud40ai4992jodmatmgfraj7o_rp22sh2s8i6eo32clge4oj2cjh2bs)

With the retirement of Joe Manchin in West Virginia, we know that Michigan’s open Senate seat will be even more critical in determining whether or not Democrats maintain control of the Senate next year. And this poll makes it clear that, as a swing state, nothing in Michigan is ever guaranteed.

The Detroit Free Press said: ”But it's such a small lead — well within the margin of error — that it could indicate trouble for Democrats in retaining the seat...Such large numbers of undecided voters make it clear that all of the candidates still have a lot of ground to make up in introducing themselves to voters.”

**ICYMI: John Teichert Addresses Crisis in Maryland Education **
**BALTIMORE, Md.** – In case you missed it, retired Brigadier General and U.S. Senate Candidate, John Teichert, called out the crisis affecting Maryland children in a recent column, **“Our Classrooms are in Crisis,”** published in _The Annapolis Capital Gazette_.
Teichert’s column explains how teacher’s union control, political agendas, and lack of parental rights in schools has dissolved Maryland’s education system, leaving children in the dust and ill-prepared for the real world.
The piece included the story of a Hispanic mother who, after watching her children struggle with their public schooling, decided to homeschool her children. Teichert continues the story by writing, **“Our educational system is consumed by a real crisis, depriving our youth of the opportunities they deserve. It is irreversibly harming our children and condemning them to a future separated from the American Dream while pumping extensive financial resources into a system that is failing to produce results. Our kids and our families deserve much better.”**
**“Our Classrooms are in Crisis”** comes at a time when many of our public schools are testing exceedingly below proficiency in subjects like math and reading, and the teachers’ union are lining their pockets at the expense of students. **“The school system in Maryland is trapped by a teacher’s union control that embraces the status quo and elevates mediocrity. It is the same group that recklessly locked our kids out of schools, leading to irreparable damage to students throughout the state,”** Teichert wrote on the matter.
As a candidate for the U.S. Senate, Teichert is committed to instilling a parental bill of rights so Maryland parents have a say in their child’s education and is a supporter of implementing school choice policies to ensure every student has the opportunity to learn in an environment that meets their needs.
Read senate candidate John Teichert’s full opinion piece in _The Annapolis Capital Gazette_ [here.](https://teichertformaryland.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1ec0c6fa331e836475672e631&id=a83fbe3a99&e=1b1fb1ad9f)

| Dear Fellow American,

We’re rapidly coming to the end of the year, and I want to update you on some important new developments in our work fighting for you and the rule of law.
And I hope that you will will help us push forward on all these fronts...and more...with [a special contribution today! Your decision to support us now, before the end of the year, is so important!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66187&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

---

* The **Minnesota Court of Appeals** reversed a lower court ruling and has allowed Judicial Watch's lawsuit on behalf of a **Minneapolis** taxpayer over a teachers' contract that provides discriminatory job protections to certain racial minorities to proceed.

This is a big courtroom victory for Judicial Watch _and_ for taxpayers who are outraged that Minneapolis' school system would engage in blatant racial discrimination that we argue violates the Equal Protection Clause in the Minnesota Constitution, as well as the basic constitutional principle that no one can be denied equal treatment under the laws on account of race!

* We have officially "warned" the **States of Illinois** and **California** that our data research and analysis show they are in violation of federal law that requires states to make a reasonable effort to clean their voter rolls of ineligible voters...and we are ready to file a federal lawsuit against them if they fail to correct this violation.

And after receiving a similar "warning" from Judicial Watch, the **District of Columbia** has removed over 65,000 outdated names from its voter rolls, promised to remove nearly 38,000 more and designated over 73,000 registrations as inactive ... _another win for Judicial Watch and for honest elections_!

"Dirty" voter rolls are an open invitation to voter fraud. Our historic lawsuits have already forced the removal of **over 4 million** ineligible voter names from voter lists across the country...and I anticipate we will be warning more states soon. Stay tuned!

* Our lawsuit against the National Archives and Records Administration for key Biden family communications regarding travel and finance transactions recently forced the release of records that show Joe Biden and his son Hunter both received an email in 2016 from a Biden staffer about an upcoming phone call between then-Vice President Biden and the president of Ukraine. This email is _another_ smoking gun that blows out of the water the continued Biden White House assertions that there was "distance" between Joe and Hunter Biden on the Burisma influence-peddling scandal!

The White House can try and ignore the evidence of Biden corruption, but [**Judicial Watch is on the case and we will not let them engage in yet another cover-up!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66187&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=66187&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Eleven years since Sandy Hook
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
This unfathomable loss is one that we will never, ever forget
#

Friends -
Today marks eleven years since the tragedy at Sandy Hook Elementary School in Newtown, Connecticut.
On this devastating day, twenty innocent children were robbed of the chance to grow up. Six teachers who were simply doing their job never made it home from work.
I wanted to take a moment today to ask you to join me in keeping the families impacted by the tragedy in your hearts. This unfathomable loss is one that we will never, ever forget.
Shortly after the tragedy, I traveled to Newtown to spend time with families grieving an unspeakable loss.
We gathered in a living room filled with parents of some of the children killed in their classrooms, as well as family members of some of the teachers who lost their lives. After talking to every family there that day, tearing up at every picture of the innocent victims who lost their lives, I remember walking to a chair in the corner, collapsing into it and saying, "Enough."
A few short weeks later, we launched our gun safety organization, then known as Americans for Responsible Solutions. I could have never guessed that ever since that day, we would have built a coalition of millions of people—just like you—committed to our mission to save lives from gun violence.
In the eleven years since the Sandy Hook tragedy, I can tell you confidently that the work we’ve done together has changed hearts, changed minds, and changed laws. But the fight isn’t over yet. We must keep up our work to demand more from our elected officials and get commonsense gun safety legislation passed.
Please keep standing with me in this fight.
Onward,
Gabby Giffords

Dear Fellow Patriot,

The next presidential administration could be a turning point for our country.

After years of inflation, open borders, reckless spending, and rampant crime, America desperately needs effective governance grounded in our founding principles.

Unfortunately, a conservative victory in the next election is not enough to save our country.

That's because today, the deep state controls D.C.

**Regardless of who is in office, career bureaucrats in our federal agencies like the Justice Department, Environmental Protection Agency, and the State Department independently push their own leftist agendas.

** In order to implement common-sense, conservative policies, we must have a plan to rein in these agencies and replace these leftist bureaucrats with principled conservatives.

The Heritage Foundation has that plan--called Project 2025.

**Through Project 2025, The Heritage Foundation has united 80 conservative organizations and is leading the charge for the next presidential transition plan.**

Heritage's policy scholars created a comprehensive policy book and a plan to implement it starting day one of the next administration.

These policies include securing our borders, ensuring election integrity, and reversing the growth of regulations, spending, and inflation.

Additionally, we're identifying and training qualified patriots to staff the next administration and replace the leftist bureaucrats - ending their control of the deep state.

It’s no wonder she’s failed to fix the real problems facing our communities during her two decades in Congress. Folks, there’s no denying it — Marsha Blackburn is just plain wrong for Tennessee. But defeating her will NOT be easy. I’m proud not to take a cent of corporate PAC money to fund this race. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. _Hi, it’s Gabby Giffords. My friend Bob Casey needs our help to win re-election in Pennsylvania and defend the Senate majority._**_[I hope you’ll read my message below and donate to make sure Bob reaches his fundraising goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20231214-1?refcode=em20231214-1&refcode2=1381_552475_w0ygzk&akid=1381%2E552475%2Ew0ygzk)_**

Peter,
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to support my friend Bob Casey in his fight to defend Pennsylvania’s must-win Senate seat. But first, give me a chance to explain why this is so important.
So much is on the line next fall – now more than ever, we need gun safety champions like Bob in office to pass lifesaving measures like universal background checks and bans on the sale of assault weapons and high capacity magazines. Bob has also led efforts to prevent people convicted of hate crimes from accessing guns and provide more resources to victims of gun violence.
I know just how hard these campaigns can be, and Bob is facing his toughest one yet. But I also know that he has what it takes to win. Bob has won tough races before and can do it again – but not without an army of grassroots supporters like you.
Right now, Bob is falling short of his $50,000 fundraising goal and needs our help to get back on track. As we face everything from attacks on our rights to surging gun violence across the country, Bob Casey’s fierce voice is one we can’t afford to lose.
So please, I’m personally asking, Peter:[**Will you give $5 or more today to join me in supporting Bob Casey’s campaign? Anything you can spare will go a long way toward holding the Senate majority.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20231214-1?refcode=em20231214-1&refcode2=1381_552475_w0ygzk&akid=1381%2E552475%2Ew0ygzk)

Thank you so much,
Gabby Giffords

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

I was forcefully handcuffed, then moved to the FBI building.

My wife asked for the search warrant several times, but didn't get it until after the FBI agents finished searching our home.

Can you imagine being treated like this in America?

My lawyer, Larry Klayman, filed this crucial lawsuit.

Larry is founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

He's a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 41 years.

You've seen him on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**Larry took on Bill Clinton, and is the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President committed a crime.**

Larry knows what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.

**And with this critically important case, Larry can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

body:
The details on where to go.

View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/7271e9741860/re-hey-9335730?e=d30db4cde8)
Friend,

I wanted to share some important information ahead of our big holiday receptions Sunday and Monday.

For those of you attending the St. Thomas reception on Sunday, please park your car at Antilles School. We will have a shuttle running from the parking lot to the private residence hosting the reception beginning at 5:30 p.m. The reception starts at 6 p.m. If you have an issue, the shuttle driver Roy can be reached at 340-998-0314.

For those of you attending the St. Croix reception on Monday, as previously announced the reception will be held at The Fred Hotel in Frederiksted. Doors open at 6 p.m. with the general admission program beginning at 6:30 p.m.

If you have any questions, let me know.

I hope to see you Sunday or Monday.

Forward,
Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley

Fellow Conservative,

It’s Montana U.S. Senate candidate Tim Sheehy.

body:
Chairman Jim Walsh is joining citizens and volunteers as the third initiative gets submitted to the Secretary of State's office in Tumwater.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

name: Dr. Cornel West
subject: A COPout with Global Implications
body:
Rather than a mandate to phase out and eventually eliminate the use of fossil fuels, COP 28 concluded with perfunctory semantics that don’t compel high emitting nations like ours to take requisite actions necessary to avert the worst impacts of climate change

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/r?u=psQUkJGc26u6Wi0imicX-00jZnUVaZYVu06OFU-xtOc&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231223copout&n=1)
---
Dear Peter, As the annual Conference of Parties (COP) global climate conference concludes in Dubai, over 100,000 people, including valiant civil society organizations representing frontline nations, environmental justice and Indigenous communities, and myriad concerned global citizens are departing disappointed, despondent, and dejected at a time when our planet is warming at an accelerated rate and this year will mark the highest level of carbon dioxide emissions from the burning of fossil fuels ever.[i] **Climate change is not some distant end point, it’s here right now and it’s taking lives, disproportionately Indigenous, Black, Brown, and poor, right now.** And rather than a mandate to phase out and eventually eliminate the use of fossil fuels, COP 28 concluded with perfunctory semantics that don’t compel high emitting nations like ours to take requisite actions necessary to avert the worst impacts of climate change. COP 28 did not end with a “historic agreement” it ended with waving a white flag and issuing a declaration of disaster for frontline, developing nations as well as Indigenous and other environmental justice communities the world over. [Click Here to Contribute to Brother West’s Campaign for Global Green Reconstruction Initiative Deliver True Climate Justice for All](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=27&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231223copout&n=2)
---
[ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?amount=27&e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=20231223copout&n=3)
---
We have to be honest – the lack of global climate leadership the world just witnessed is directly tied to the lack of climate leadership right here in the U.S. Whether it’s the De Jure climate denialism of the GOP who are bankrolled with crude cash from the fossil fuel industry, or the De Facto climate denialism of the Democrats who are _bankrolling_ the fossil fuel industry with billions of dollars from the milquetoast Inflation Reduction Act, we simply cannot count on the derelict duopoly to deliver us to climate justice. As the only presidential candidate to attend the March to End Fossil Fuels in New York City, I keenly understand that the fossil fuel industry simply has too much power over both parties, just as they have too much influence at COP 28 with over 2,500 lobbyists in attendance. And while Big Oil may have big money, we have something more powerful – BIG IDEAS and People Power. My plan for a global green reconstruction initiative will hold the fossil fuel industry accountable for a century of environmental racism once and for all by nationalizing it as part of a larger plan of dismantling it. And with your help, by COP 30 in Brazil, the U.S fossil fuel industry will no longer have any influence over a global climate conference – we, the people, will. Can I count on you to help me deliver climate justice?
---

## Supreme Court to Review Key Jan. 6 Charges
The Supreme Court has agreed to review a case that could [derail hundreds of Jan. 6](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=510170c0451040f686259db96fbc9e9d&_e=Y16QwNiHWxFVV0FS4cSc3f0LHK-O87XZsG-UpnYUTwGx7cHNUxcbNTgis0ufG81FrZxPFcO9mpqFX6olvuG22kQEHimUxwgL7cKZuAV3OWVo4fPCjgvM-0kj2HL1WFRG4jAUdSysl1AhsSxtziny4mcA8iRxJPMfAPIdgJSvHgE6B2SOifJIB3CPwlKpE_dEzZSXpjv6ErtgaNQvOY9IACrbfujmvfA2YAbZPyIsdVIjBv_NQHGnfwwiJu4iXaBOvw93BpnlOISiapzcgpWRWg%3D%3D) felony prosecutions and impact the criminal charges against Donald Trump. At issue is an appeal by a Jan. 6 defendant who claims the charge of "obstruction of an official proceeding," based on an Enron-era law designed to punish [the shredding of documents](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=510170c0451040f686259db96fbc9e9d&_e=Y16QwNiHWxFVV0FS4cSc3dtJqmu16LEkS1WDWuifOIit2z6VoekMZ4rUa83gyZQd6LLfu59Q0Vy-bg5lTT0kftVg8BfXTt0H8lPY87vOmgdKegqmdYM-fjop2k9Oq81MGarNIDTti7Z6MC7bN98fWOTvnJL6O3iiNLNUiw-T3d-2Z5IxvD1f9pUUfpgkLM1T5-_eVGdrE84Ke9S01SrjCrvxwZMgrm9lMmQDaYszhUi1JZdCEvnF7Fc_zShU44ogobF5XCbPPzjX8gzKs8BkoLb7HVYR6kbcqUrNYFyu_6r2tdvyGFeUxns4eLDPiGSQwEeXfxQ0g5VS5ZbZBkJZ1jvnWOxMa8kUuKp5FXhQ4RM%3D), shouldn't be used against the Jan. 6 defendants. The government says the law covers any kind of obstruction and not just physical tampering of documents. It carries a penalty of up to 20 years in jail and has been used in most of the Jan. 6 prosecutions. It's also one of the charges against Trump.
## Hunter Biden Skips Deposition
Hunter Biden refused to sit for a deposition in Congress on Wednesday, instead holding a press conference at the Capitol that raised [questions about President Biden's](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=510170c0451040f686259db96fbc9e9d&_e=Y16QwNiHWxFVV0FS4cSc3TFM8jzQjwDMMNJ6iD0nP8NW9Siv8FNcXhvEQulshU-s8Fb0L_10YirD-lYyud5VI_pXwH7vy8phkrIMKVEnCUJNeRz_kb6YWqi64hKyTs8-Ozi1b249mVDvtp2Q-C7VSMkjbuNC_dadVV_WLMv_OTBX7BIQF21Y9jvyyW4ZNj0jV7rrh7pNJx9H9M4_3z4uBY0cK-B0aNevtWgFZnS0KfOg4dqDVMl3GyyxtTUg0QBbCBwh7YZAR8_wxEymcQ2QiI51JFsASjMbQZJHxE9BoSSwTZoXCN0dxqLLXrSGI7cetD0tfO6veCM0IhWyfsw7ew%3D%3D) previous statements about his involvement in Hunter's business. Hunter faced an immediate backlash among Republicans in Congress, who want [to hold him in contempt](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=510170c0451040f686259db96fbc9e9d&_e=Y16QwNiHWxFVV0FS4cSc3TV4NNVu9-ziGgktnuyMfe3EUooI1GjFRutCyJMMW4aGXL1eLSs4_qcAdF_ldKRipKdgZ3RTw5lNfzSsGlYy2yxqdw2EiTfP5kaNqW_tb_hWh1WOIqyH1oFUEdJayI65CjVbnJV4_sNhquBoUWO-x0T0VFm55lcvTrdiOl3a6qb90FMIOwQUHOdWwQTUTeE3kJloNVQxUxL4_c-SUdeCVOCbT83Mmd8Uui-e8VKjNmNPZL9JNOxLuLBR8zqiRvU7FrAMvuZZXEPArgfr2kRO3RI%3D). But others focused on his statements that his father was never financially involved in business with him. In earlier statements, President Biden has clearly stated that he never discussed business with Hunter ([See Video Here](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=510170c0451040f686259db96fbc9e9d&_e=Y16QwNiHWxFVV0FS4cSc3e5r1rT5tj8TRkf3rsT8uFl8gb4OUYZq5muhtY8AKws7e6u-kdUE4OCJ1xcdos_d-1KuybWV-OeiiT0qxzWUa3yj3exa8RJLEyTFHzDz7p6uXEfhU40zN5jPPWElKlRZoLYQRE_pYqPNq6TLLsZFTBLL8JJbt7wh46Pp--FGF64s6g_fmRE7NlplYKDCW60ZICQ93TU2PaXwKZJAbPDVZWHfHDLbbwyNlOEbNWJXeooRt2ztmrin_RGggT7v1XCt-6BWLRWjOZ687RtGB1BzF2Qlw0X-IHI19Xpl5TXYqMxbqw8aySgJlftwzMgsvyLu3ZTksDoJiZGZ0oiny72zaUo3UupFC0puQ9gXxOgx2EfXXP4eMz5tC1cs1_C7i-eAvyPbhFERTRKBkzmgW4w3XgEdtxHcVReyMCuNukh5vYRolg1VkZ00z9h9ch5UlQqheT6GMFn8aZU0gn0wzR09B8TQCeO1FksfmtND-bplvoV_Mz1Qld8Sn0TQVG6bO9-HynG3Z1u_vahEHRhZtHnMuWlkfjI4tWQwyJwdRbF8KVyO0JYYtq1U1i3YVkj8KS9jqQ%3D%3D)). But Hunter's statements shifted that to never _doing_ business, a "huge change," said Rep. Jim Jordan.

This is the kind of sleight of hand that voters are tired of seeing in our elected officials. Bob can talk about supporting public education all he wants – but the truth is that he doesn’t know our schools the way I do.

I graduated from Foster High School in Tukwila in 1990, and my wife Kelley is a teacher in the Issaquah School District. All six of our children have attended Issaquah public schools.

I'm the longest serving member on the Senate Education Committee, and I’m proud of the work we’ve done to invest in financial literacy programs and College in the High School program to open up opportunities for all students.

My campaign is endorsed by the Public School Employees (SEIU Local 1948) because they know I look at the big picture view of our system to recognize the importance of paraeducators, school bus drivers, front office personnel, custodians, and cafeteria workers.

body:
Today I wanted to share a more personal story. | | | Hi Peter — Carolina here. You’ve probably seen my name in your inbox before, with updates on DACA and the work we’re doing, but today, I wanted to share a more personal story. I was born in Brazil but moved to the United States when I was 9 years old. I am a DACA recipient. Being undocumented, I never felt like I could plan my life too far ahead because I never knew what would happen next. When I got DACA, everything changed — I could get a driver’s license, have a stable job, and seek medical care when I need it. DACA has given me a bit more stability, but it only comes in two year increments — and with DACA vulnerable to far-right attacks in the court, it’s still not enough to feel safe. We need permanent protections so that all of us can be free to live and thrive in the communities we’re a part of. DACA was never more than a band-aid solution. After Judge Hanen’s decision against DACA just a few months ago, we have the momentum to push Congress and President Biden for more. **Can we count on you to pitch in $10 today to demand more from the elected officials who promised to protect us? DACA has given me a bit more stability, but it only comes in two year increments — and with DACA vulnerable to far-right attacks in the court, it’s still not enough to feel safe. We need permanent protections so that all of us can be free to live and thrive in the communities we’re a part of. DACA was never more than a band-aid solution. After Judge Hanen’s decision against DACA just a few months ago, we have the momentum to push Congress and President Biden for more. Can we count on you to pitch in $10 today to demand more from the elected officials who promised to protect us? Our fight for permanent protections has never been more urgent: ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | When I was younger, I often felt voiceless. That was until college, when I found the immigrant rights movement. I met people who were not afraid of speaking up, who were fighting for their rights — in the streets protesting, in the Capitol meeting with policy makers, and in schools creating educational programs. After a lifetime of feeling powerless, I had found a purpose, I was empowered. If others were making an impact — I could too. Then, in 2010, I got connected with the United We Dream community. I finally felt like I had a purpose. I felt empowered to advocate for myself, stand up against injustice, and help others do the same. Will you pitch in today to help empower even more immigrant youth to stand up for themselves and their communities?** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | I know building the power we need to fight for a better future for our immigrant communities is not easy. But it will always be worth it. Thanks for being on the team! Carolina, United We Dream Action

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---
After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States.

I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again.

I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country.

I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A.

I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer.

_**I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! **_

I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better.

**As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor"** because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery.

**At the UN I fought for America,** made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names.

I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. **And I 'll do it as your next President. **

As President, I'll revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington's spending sprees, protect our border, champion school choice, and save America's future.

Generosity from grassroots supporters like you is the reason I am able to fund my campaign and fight for America's future. Now, I want to take a few minutes to talk with you about the journey I have been on. "Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me fund my campaign so I can get my message out to every voter!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and hardly anyone thought I had a chance. I was polling at 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. ➡️ | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them. | Now, I'm running for President because our country is heading down a path of doubt, division, and self-destruction. We need a leader who will rise to the occasion, offer solutions, and prioritize serving the people over the political class. "It would mean a lot to me if every single person reading this today could send a donation of just $5 to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG! >>" Your donation will not only show that my campaign is a force to be reckoned with, but it will also play a vital role in helping fund our campaign in the upcoming days. "Will you consider making a one-time donation of any amount today to show the strength of OUR movement?" | | Friend, throughout my life, I've been shaking up the status quo. I'm hoping to do the same as your next President. But in order to get there, "I need your help – starting right now. " Your contribution is what keeps this movement alive and thriving, so thank you for standing with me. My very best, | Nikki Haley | | | | | | | | "NikkiHaleyMerch" | | "Claim Your Mug" | | More About Nikki Haley | "NikkiHaleyPodium" My name is Nikki Haley. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I'm running for President of the United States. I'm running for President because my parents came to America more than 50 years ago - an America that was strong and proud, and full of opportunities. I want them to know that America again. I'm running for President as a military spouse. My husband is deployed and I want him and his military brothers and sisters to know their sacrifice means something - that we do love this country. I'm running for President for the future of our kids. I have a daughter who just got married and I saw how hard it was for her and her husband to buy a home. I'm doing this for my son who's a senior in college and shouldn't have to worry about saying things on a paper that he doesn't believe in just to get an A. I'm running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. I 'm running for President because we have a country to save! I've seen that even on our worst days, we are blessed to live in America. But I also know that under Biden's leadership, times are tough, our future is slipping, and America can be doing so much better. As governor, I was dubbed a "jobs governor" because I slashed our unemployment rate, brought jobs back to our state, and shepherded in a successful economic recovery. At the UN I fought for America, made sure our allies knew we had their backs and stood up to murderers and dictators to let them know that America was taking names. I know how to make America strong and proud because I've done it before. And I 'll do it as your next President. Derek, House Republicans officially authorized an impeachment inquiry of President Biden in the U.S. House of Representatives.
So please allow me a moment to explain why this is so important:
**Republicans don’t have evidence of any wrongdoing by President Joe Biden — even _Fox_ commentators have acknowledged as much — and they don’t care.** The facts are not what’s important to them. Tarnishing Joe Biden politically to ease Donald Trump’s path back to the White House — that’s what matters to them.
_It’s a similar playbook to the one they used against Hillary Clinton, called Benghazi._
In 2015, a far-right Republican House majority opened a bogus investigation of Hillary Clinton. Even though there was no evidence of wrongdoing on her part, Kevin McCarthy told _Fox News_ , _**“Everybody thought Hillary Clinton was unbeatable, right? But we put together a Benghazi special committee, a select committee. What are her numbers today? Her numbers are dropping.”**_
Derek, it worked.
Now they are at it again. Republicans will stop at nothing to get Donald Trump back in the Oval Office. We know they will.
**[That’s why it’s critical that we build the resources to fight back against these dirty political tactics and support Democrats up and down the ballot. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75168586/443836092/1272516037?refcode=em_XX_XXXX.XX.XX_XX_XX_header_desk_of_andrei&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzIxODVmNzctYWQ5YS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=5OToUvjo7cmDalW8dUm_ALn830bh4_ZAlptZ-u9UiiA=) Peter, tonight, on the last night of Hanukkah, I wanted to reach out to explain what this holiday means to me.

To me, Hanukkah is more than the presents and the games – though the house party we had earlier this month where the hosts made “An-dreidel” cookies was a lot of fun. Rather, it's a festival of light.

It’s been said that it is better to light a single candle than curse the darkness a thousand times. And in the midst of the darkest time of the year, we light candles. Not a great big bonfire or even torchlight. Just simple candles, one at a time for eight nights.

Whatever your faith, however you celebrate, that’s what the holiday season means to me – families and friends coming together in the community. Those are the true candles banishing the darkness all around us; the hope that drives out the forces of hate.

And that’s ultimately what this campaign is all about to me. So today, as we near the big year-end fundraising deadline that will mean so much to our success, I ask for your help.

In Hebrew, each letter has a numerical value. The number 18 spells Chai (חי), which means life. Rather, it's a festival of light. It’s been said that it is better to light a single candle than curse the darkness a thousand times. And in the midst of the darkest time of the year, we light candles. Not a great big bonfire or even torchlight. Just simple candles, one at a time for eight nights. I served for 25 years in the U.S. Army. I know firsthand that our democracy is not gifted to us. I have witnessed soldiers die in front of me. I have seen the price paid by heroes both in and out of uniform to defend our freedom. **MAGA politicians disgrace those sacrifices by helping Donald Trump willfully tear our constitution to shreds.** Making it harder for people to vote, trying to overturn election results, and inciting an insurrection against our democracy. Those actions are shameful, and the people who aid or enable them are villains or cowards. That’s why, when the most vulnerable Democratic district in Maryland became an open race, I knew I had to step up to ensure that this must-win seat stays blue. I’m an Army veteran who knows democracy is earned through sacrifice. I’ve had enough of politicians who are destroying our democracy. Together we can defeat divisive politics and focus on serving the people, but that requires a movement of grassroots supporters. _Friend: Democracy isn’t a single-player sport, and neither is securing it._ [**If you are in this fight with me, will you please consider pitching in a donation before midnight tomorrow? clean_body: | | Hi there, My name is Geoffrey Grammer, retired U.S. Army colonel and physician running for U.S. Congress in Maryland’s 6th District open seat. Do you remember the 2022 midterm elections, waiting for days to see the final districts get called as control of the U.S. House of Representatives hung in the balance? Yes, MD-06 was one of those seats you waited on. Now, the GOP’s top-tier recruit kicked off his campaign just last month and is fundraising like crazy. Republicans are eyeing this seat because a blue-to-red flip here virtually ensures they keep their House Majority. The fight to flip back the House starts right here,and I’m in this to win . | I served for 25 years in the U.S. Army. I know firsthand that our democracy is not gifted to us. I have witnessed soldiers die in front of me. I have seen the price paid by heroes both in and out of uniform to defend our freedom. MAGA politicians disgrace those sacrifices by helping Donald Trump willfully tear our constitution to shreds. Making it harder for people to vote, trying to overturn election results, and inciting an insurrection against our democracy. Those actions are shameful, and the people who aid or enable them are villains or cowards. That’s why, when the most vulnerable Democratic district in Maryland became an open race, I knew I had to step up to ensure that this must-win seat stays blue. I’m an Army veteran who knows democracy is earned through sacrifice. I’ve had enough of politicians who are destroying our democracy. Together we can defeat divisive politics and focus on serving the people, but that requires a movement of grassroots supporters. Friend: Democracy isn’t a single-player sport, and neither is securing it. Hi there, It’s Tom Suozzi, the Democratic nominee in the special election to replace George Santos.
I wanted to tell you a bit more about why this race is so important to me.
My father was born in Italy, and like so many, his family came in search of the American Dream. He found it in New York, and I’m so grateful he did. He taught my brother and sister and I to work hard and to work for our community. He inspired my public service as Mayor of Glen Cove, Nassau County Executive, and U.S. Representative.
But increasingly, the American Dream is out of reach for so many. The cost of living is way too high, people don’t feel safe on the streets, and our leaders are too busy with arguments and petty politics to solve problems like climate change or our broken immigration system.
And to make matters worse, George Santos represented NY-03 for 11 months, in which he did nothing other than distract and divide us until he was finally expelled.
Now, there’s a special election in NY-03 on February 13, and I’m humbly asking for your support. This race is a toss-up, so grassroots support really matters. We need to bring sanity back to our government so we can rebuild the American Dream. Can I count on you to pitch in now -- split evenly with Seth Moulton? Could this possibly be an effort to divert the attention of news outlets from the intensifying legal situation with the January 6 insurrection? Perhaps they want to do something ✨big✨ as an attempt to distract voters from the months of chaos and dysfunction thanks to GOP leadership in the House? Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. -- Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Team, I’m reaching out with a quick personal request:

**Will you donate to the NDRC before the year-end deadline? Anything you give will help us reach our 2023 fundraising goal so we can continue our fight for fair maps ahead of the 2024 election.**

If you’re able to give, you can use this link: [**_https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndrc-presidentobama_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75177988/443852888/-1466375647?amount=30&refcode=EM_RTI_20231214_FR_12H_redlight922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlhYTU1NTI1LWI1OWEtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TzbmojkYiEsfJ9uzn9s4YNAzF9wrV8rkwENjf32hIdg=)

Ahead of last year’s midterm elections, NDRC helped secure what the _New York Times_ called “the fairest House map of the last forty years.” We couldn’t have done it without supporters like you.

But our fight against gerrymandering is far from over. As President Obama recently said, **“Redistricting is no longer a once-a-decade event. The fight for fair maps is happening right now.”**

That’s because there are still several states that could draw new maps before next year’s election – with more than enough congressional districts in play to swing control of the House.

That means we have two options: (1) We can do nothing and let the GOP roll back our progress by forcing through manipulated maps.

(2) We can keep fighting and secure _even fairer_ maps ahead of a highly consequential election. **The NDRC is committed to continuing to fight for fair maps across the country, and we’re counting on our grassroots supporters to stick with us. If you're able, will you make an urgent donation today?**

You can use this link to make sure your gift counts toward our year-end fundraising goal: [**_https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ndrc-presidentobama_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75177989/443852889/-1466375647?amount=30&refcode=EM_RTI_20231214_FR_12H_redlight922_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjlhYTU1NTI1LWI1OWEtZWUxMS1iZWExLTAwMjI0ODIyM2YzNiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=TzbmojkYiEsfJ9uzn9s4YNAzF9wrV8rkwENjf32hIdg=)

Thank you for being part of this movement, team.

Fellow American, you may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day,_I’m still just a dad from Louisiana._

Here is what you need to know: I am a steadfast believer in our Lord and Savior, a husband to my incredible wife Kelly, and father to four wonderful kids. I come to DC week in and week out to fight for their futures and the future of our country.

When people ask Kelly and I why we keep going and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, our answer is simple: “This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”

Part of this new role is asking folks like you to make donations so that we can be successful in our effort to grow the majority. I’m not quite used to this part of the job yet, but I’ll get there because I care so deeply for the cause we are fighting for. **I want to hand down to our kids the freest, most thriving version of our country so they have a chance to live out the American dream.**

name: Katie Porter
subject: A longer message about why this primary election matters
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
There’s so much more to our job than the vote we take.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=34768%2E3422442%2E72kS27)
Derek, I’m often asked why California’s Senate election matters. If we’re so likely to elect a Democrat, why should people care?
**While Democrats often end up taking the same votes, there’s so much more to our job than just voting yes or no.**
Much of the important work we do here in Washington is what people don’t always see. Realistically, we can’t all be a champion or expert on every single issue. So each elected official decides where to most focus their time, energy, and capital. Here’s where I plan to focus mine in the U.S. Senate:
1. Since being elected in 2018, **I’ve been laser-focused on the environment** , and my work holding Big Oil accountable differentiates me from many of my colleagues. I’ve always been willing to push for aggressive climate change legislation, reject money from the fossil fuel industry, and treat climate change as the existential threat it is. That includes making sure Democrats are correctly messaging around climate—and not letting Republicans convince voters that Democrats are ruining lives with electric stoves.
2. **Lowering the cost of housing.** We have to stop running our housing policy to benefit Wall Street. The federal government needs to take a far more active role in creating affordable housing.
3. **Clean up corruption and shake up the status quo.** Special interest groups and corporations have had an outsized influence in Washington for far too long. Too many Members of Congress and Supreme Court Justices are beholden to donors or their own stock portfolios. If we want to enact gun violence protection, restore the right to an abortion, or lower drug costs, we have to get to the root of the problem here in Washington.

Derek, it’s not enough just to have a [D] next to your name. We need to elect Democrats who are willing to speak truth to power and tackle our country’s biggest issues.
I’m the only candidate in this race who has never taken corporate PAC money, so if we’re going to win this race, I need your help. **[Can you donate $5 today to help us win our competitive primary and shake up the Senate?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231214-1?refcode=EMAO23_1_VOT_20231114_V1_F&refcode2=34768_3422442_72kS27&akid=34768%2E3422442%2E72kS27)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20231214-1?refcode=EMAO23_1_VOT_20231114_V1_F&refcode2=34768_3422442_72kS27&akid=34768%2E3422442%2E72kS27)
Thanks for reading,
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAO23_1_VOT_20231114_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=34768_3422442_72kS27&akid=34768%2E3422442%2E72kS27)**

body:
Peter,

As you know, our goal as Georgia House Democrats is to build a better Georgia - a state where equal opportunity exists for all and where every vote counts.

Thanks to your help, we’ve managed to post some wins along the way this year:

Blocking Kemp’s School Voucher Bill - SB 233 professed to be a safety net for low-income children in failing public schools. Instead, it was just another means of siphoning taxpayer dollars from public schools and transferring them to private schools with no oversight. Thanks to your support, we were able to put a stop to this attack on our schools and keep the money where it belongs: in place to improve public education.

Digital Ad Campaigns - We don’t generally start running digital ads until election years. But this year we started communicating with voters early in our top targeted seats. We’re happy to report that the campaigns drove amazing response - so much so that you’ll see them frequently repeated in 2024.

Staunchly Defending Against Illegal Reapportionment - We supported the lawsuits against the GOP’s unfair voting districts all the way. And we’re being vocal about how the GOP has redrawn the districts, expressly violating the issuing judge’s instructions not to disturb any Opportunity Districts while doing so. We fully anticipate these new illegal maps to be contested in court, and will do our level best to see that the challenges proceed quickly and smoothly, so that Georgia has the right maps for the 2024 election.

What do we need now? To keep up the momentum. 2024 is an election year and we'll be laser-focused on flipping seats and taking a Democratic Majority. Please continue to support us however you can - the result will be a better Georgia for everyone.

Friend,
Running a campaign can be a difficult task, but the people of our communities make it better.
That's why we're all about la gente and my commitment to create more opportunities for our working families, our students, and our community.
You see, serving the people of South Texas is the honor of my life.
For more than 20 years, I fought in the courtroom to support working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility, recovering millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in danger.
Now, I am proud to represent South Texas in Congress, but I need your support once again to fight for the values that matter the most to us, protect our Social Security and Medicare, and deliver billions of dollars to repair our roads, improve drainage, and invest in our public schools.
Getting the support of organizations and leaders is great, but the best thing is to receive the support of the residents who see the struggles every day and want to see change made.
Friend, I am ready to continue working for South Texas and for you in Congress , which is why we need you with us.
As a grassroots campaign, we believe in the power of the people—the ones who understand the challenges faced by our community and hope for positive change.
Friend, as the only Democrat running for the seat so far, this race is a MUST-HOLD competitive seat for Democrats in Texas and across the country, making your endorsement a powerful statement that reflects the voices of those who truly matter— will you join our team and endorse my campaign today? ENDORSE VICENTE TODAY [https://uzuuyxxh.paperform.co]
In unity,
Congressman Vicente Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://uzuuyxxh.paperform.co [https://uzuuyxxh.paperform.co]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

## Supreme Court to Review Key Jan. 6 Charges
The Supreme Court has agreed to review a case that could [derail hundreds of Jan. 6](http://links.freeamericansforever.com/u/click?_t=def7bfae8aeb4bc7978e654943fded95&_m=0f99d411b836490b99bdea1840c1be18&_e=QJzmt_Lk06zna2HK-K60IVYTVrlgogNXLcm6g-v0PgLEzPsVWoQaFt6-82ZXLpuz1DhP73oJLnXg1h0HRhyoxUUHq9HRGgC-E1KYPtlpmR5ZkUM4OOG1d1cu-dhAVOvQy3hcJ4VYWYivYUSbDswTE3m3R3Wwr1tAIAkGJggOsKlAIkn65sLY0d78CI3HMwhHCXrOvS9PgeUcH05ThTibqTCp6uvuxL20qLeR1-HkejOoaLd9FoVnzkS8xkexFCqLgVGZNbjE-e5wL5ghpkgf1g%3D%3D) felony prosecutions and impact the criminal charges against Donald Trump. At issue is an appeal by a Jan. 6 defendant who claims the charge of "obstruction of an official proceeding," based on an Enron-era law designed to punish [the shredding of documents](http://links.freeamericansforever.com/u/click?_t=def7bfae8aeb4bc7978e654943fded95&_m=0f99d411b836490b99bdea1840c1be18&_e=QJzmt_Lk06zna2HK-K60IfoRV6bDITGxuwpCI_FscO91j5Ty4fQ1gMtUI-1TBhc4p6HQr5iitv9iOXIKWo9-PgqfrIyb4V3NzEyeE09r-WEq-SRGdHDqC1MlBQ73Bzu8N2nSeglkHkCqDM5Dpq12BiGuYvXvamaIshLqcOsv0nZUasB-vLutf99YTBrLlGbnrEoMu6hFeiIFQ98bW19wzrHGBEsP6rd0Ymw0SCeAA5iM79r0FRkRuFPgYn84WuodSttu9aDAQcU5GGix9oTj8euvnPKZST-Pnutan9LuE099lwOrkOBo1y8vmolFeiZhpIlYxVJyB0j9IltXe2tsnHSv1VMKf6g15CXpAemrARQ%3D), shouldn't be used against the Jan. 6 defendants. The government says the law covers any kind of obstruction and not just physical tampering of documents. It carries a penalty of up to 20 years in jail and has been used in most of the Jan. 6 prosecutions. It's also one of the charges against Trump.
## Hunter Biden Skips Deposition
Hunter Biden refused to sit for a deposition in Congress on Wednesday, instead holding a press conference at the Capitol that raised [questions about President Biden's](http://links.freeamericansforever.com/u/click?_t=def7bfae8aeb4bc7978e654943fded95&_m=0f99d411b836490b99bdea1840c1be18&_e=QJzmt_Lk06zna2HK-K60IRUXxwgxocn7xjj0e4-gw6vUTwnj0p3PSfmimg8coAhxMTMruwmmVREW33mCkGYrR5pI6UDAR42MvxtYzuSp3Rmr9PgZyEpjXmCVuYuYfw6iFvuvMffg3J36ERAG9f0ebL7IO2-lOcB3mPknS_oOSvqPgYKs_Hjsb7GgEFN1xmp0MSXC9cCC5rcg_91yQS0AN9h8dA2iKq36Ple2ukyR6306_c_AaFACSxey0CVHl5MOUbeBeBAzxRP9oFW-DOY-aNDfJGrmWIq8SgobxqIUgGvX2_ULAlvV6lPb8wojnsfB1azn2pxo1QUni8P7xayhjw%3D%3D) previous statements about his involvement in Hunter's business. Hunter faced an immediate backlash among Republicans in Congress, who want [to hold him in contempt](http://links.freeamericansforever.com/u/click?_t=def7bfae8aeb4bc7978e654943fded95&_m=0f99d411b836490b99bdea1840c1be18&_e=QJzmt_Lk06zna2HK-K60IeQSNJ_1gy_8anmAOQSvgFeMb_K0Kg-5sguYxrSS60y0F9rXbHoTw-yK3wGkkVHkIz-4r3vUOem-UZXukJN8T-GiMz6LsRSpcfqQNu_eIXvTWZTTgrKPNI2XqZTUIYYEYZP2fuKWTVyA3bdXzHMghuZPi9_vvaX1p9HJ3dmSJAZcKS6ISDyOoWMRFpV7Iakig5XJcdqL19OW-L187QanSK8Xmokji9AEIhhw-Yl28YjEPBRAxt8UwW1zQJqfKlOYffT71GiBpQRQtenuWFRa5_A%3D). But others focused on his statements that his father was never financially involved in business with him. In earlier statements, President Biden has clearly stated that he never discussed business with Hunter ([See Video Here](http://links.freeamericansforever.com/u/click?_t=def7bfae8aeb4bc7978e654943fded95&_m=0f99d411b836490b99bdea1840c1be18&_e=QJzmt_Lk06zna2HK-K60IYNOe9u8omyzKX_0gaUHwJfehTu2geo3mGIAmnQqGExOUSAX_BQaLgQj1-OzJDdeMK8BEdIVK2-lCYAf0Z6jMHEddV661t3vQdwI3R4gYkadm8oMKr0dUHShrhlfQAIW-Cq1xyT99z1r7QITCxL4enX_RHEpJ3HuqJSzGfUjwCI8fOjBLM9YSVuk0YdMceFSafOMhmj5reettz9Mq1h1OjBeEo0JUuSMtptsMbZvenOlAIynV5Pqkad9xrZ79mni_gZLv0z5MPuSfKuLZFwdgaf-JWmR6kMPPXZEuWgJOfdc8H-L2vvQdZ6Bkp0pFZAP99Uk8YuG2a1LK7ML0iNuKP8rvlddhLsex-pHDsfi6lLbvTUZesfsDQgPWJFRC7KqE3iMzjzpV7eaSn5r_deNHXOQhV-vHgAyhgJox4kDTdCfPCCX9eDzUZNXp0l19EFlZNXqd24PDm92fGXT-O-F-5DVCU35KmE3VMS0hZNkZ-by9VmD9Nfy4mwYUBHUeXHNMc8gKeWBkfJZG_L3GjbcvC-KAmEpXWCa4Li4q6l7jcLiA-5tclWONAX1cJrv6Pw6Mg%3D%3D)). But Hunter's statements shifted that to never _doing_ business, a "huge change," said Rep. Jim Jordan.
## List: The Most Affordable Retirement Cities
U.S. News analyzed 150 cities in America as potential retirement spots based on a variety of criteria, and from that list, it ranked the Top 10 that also have the most affordable housing. | **MOSERS board votes to phase-out investments in China** The Missouri State Employees Retirement System Board of Trustees voted 9-2 on Dec. 12 to divest approximately $190 million in investments in Chinese stocks and securities over the next three years, the St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported. The action marked a reversal from a voice vote the board took in November rejecting divestment.

State Treasurer Vivek Malek, a Republican and member of the MOSERS board, has been pushing for the system to divest Chinese holdings and campaigning on the issue as he seeks a full term next year in a crowded Republican primary against veteran GOP officeholders. Malek has never previously run for elected office; Gov. Mike Parson appointed him as treasurer in January to fill a vacancy.

MOSERS administers the pensions of most state workers and manages the investments that help fund benefits. According to the Missouri Independent, state Sen. John Rizzo, D-Independence and one of MOSERS board members opposed to the plan, accused Malek of advocating for divestment solely for political benefit and noted the system’s professional investment managers predicted financial losses should the board follow through.

Malek denied being motivated by political concerns and said withdrawing investments from China is a sound decision due to the country’s economic problems and growing aggressiveness to U.S. interests. Just hours later, however, Malek’s campaign emailed supporters taking credit for the board’s action, the Independent reported.
---

| **Appellate court rules against House in discrimination case**
A three-judge panel of Missouri Court of Appeals Western District on Dec. 12 unanimously upheld a $3.3 million judgment against the state House of Representatives brought by a former staffer who sued over disability discrimination and retaliation.

According to the court’s opinion, the former staffer worked as a legislative analyst in House Research from January 2016 to March 2017 and had been diagnosed with several mental health disorders, including Generalized Anxiety Disorder and Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, prior his employment. The staffer alleged he was denied reasonable accommodations for his disability and instead reprimanded for poor performance. The staffer further alleged he was fired by then-House Chief Clerk Adam Crumbliss, a named defendant in the case, minutes after broaching the possibility of filing a discrimination lawsuit. Crumbliss, who is named as a defendant in the case, left the House at the end of 2018 to work in Gov. Mike Parson’s administration.

Following a trial last year, a Cole County jury ruled in favor of the staffer, who was awarded $3.3 million in damages plus attorney fees. The appellate court remanded the case to the trial court to determine the amount of additional attorney fees the plaintiff should receive for prevailing on appeal. The House could appeal to the Missouri Supreme Court but would be subject to paying further plaintiff’s attorney fees should it again lose.

| **Parson's final State of the State address set for Jan. 24**
Gov. Mike Parson plans to deliver the 2024 State of the State address before a joint session of the Missouri General Assembly on Jan. 24 at 3 p.m. During the address, Parson, a Republican, will present his proposed state operating budget for the 2025 fiscal year, which begins July 1, as well as highlight his policy priorities for year.

This will be Parson’s sixth and final State of the State speech since taking office in June 2018 following the resignation of his predecessor. Term limits prevent Parson from seeking re-election next year. Following longstanding tradition, the speech will take place in the House of Representatives’ chamber.
---
|
---
| **Governor appoints St. Charles County judge to appeals court**
Gov. Mike Parson on Dec. 8 appointed St. Charles County Circuit Judge Rebeca Navarro-McKelvey to the Missouri Court of Appeals Eastern District. Navarro-McKelvey will replace Judge Kelly Broniec, whom Parson elevated to the state Supreme Court in September.

Navarro-McKelvey, a Republican, was first elected as an associate circuit judge in 2016 before winning election as a circuit judge in 2020. Prior to joining the bench, she worked as an assistant prosecuting attorney in St. Louis city and St. Charles County. She is a 2000 graduate of the University of Missouri-Columbia School of Law.

Navarro-McKelvey was one of three finalists for the vacancy selected by the Missouri Appellate Judicial Commission. The others were St. Louis County Circuit Judge Virginia Lay and St. Louis attorney Susan Peterson. The St. Louis-based Eastern District appellate court hears cases from 25 counties on the eastern side of the state plus St. Louis city.

The U.S. Small Business Administration approved Missouri’s request for assistance through the federal agency’s disaster loan program. This move makes low-interest disaster loans available to small businesses and private non-profits severely impacted by the Coronavirus (COVID-19).

The action marked a reversal from a voice vote the board took in November rejecting divestment. State Treasurer Vivek Malek, a Republican and member of the MOSERS board, has been pushing for the system to divest Chinese holdings and campaigning on the issue as he seeks a full term next year in a crowded Republican primary against veteran GOP officeholders. Malek has never previously run for elected office; Gov. Mike Parson appointed him as treasurer in January to fill a vacancy. MOSERS administers the pensions of most state workers and manages the investments that help fund benefits. According to the Missouri Independent, state Sen. John Rizzo, D-Independence and one of MOSERS board members opposed to the plan, accused Malek of advocating for divestment solely for political benefit and noted the system’s professional investment managers predicted financial losses should the board follow through. Malek denied being motivated by political concerns and said withdrawing investments from China is a sound decision due to the country’s economic problems and growing aggressiveness to U.S. interests. _Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75179077/443856979/-648836831?refcode=headerfooter-header&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmYjYxODkzYy1iODlhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GoCUAnbs5Vbg3lhUxwJGFn89P4TXz3BHH-jN8f1j9fI=)
