name: Zach Shrewsbury
subject: Are we a planet-wrecker-in-chief?
body:
Only with a new political leadership can we change the course of climate change.

| | | [ ](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaL7rDjQkL0BM84-ma7QEaVW9iBBRjyMcq4r6Ym_hhBC&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121423_cop28&n=1&v=5)
---
Dear Friend, The Conference of Parties (COP28) climate talks were delayed due to a failure to reach a consensus. The initial draft proposal released Monday did not call for a phaseout of fossil fuels. Former Vice-President and climate activist Al Gore said the draft text read "as if OPEC dictated it word for word," adding it was "of the Petrostates, by the Petrostates and for the Petrostates." At last, COP28 nations struck a deal to transition away from fossil fuels, at least on paper. The world has given notice that the fossil fuel era is over. That is the good news. Gore's strong words, however, belie U.S. hypocrisy in its stated goal to phase out fossil fuels. The U.S. has been the leading oil and gas producer for the last five years, overtaking China and Russia by 44%. The bad news is the numerous loopholes, from the carbon capture and storage (a controversial, extremely expensive, and unsafe technology) to the support for so-called transition fuels such as natural gas (still a fossil fuel) to the completely inadequate provisions for the massive financing that poorer nations require to transition to renewable energy. The fossil fuel industry still has a lifeline to profit from increasing CO2 emissions. As a U.S. Senator, I'll bring the lens of my climate activism to the office every day. But first, we have to win the election against the coal mining magnate who will likely be my opponent next November. **[Can you pitch in any amount to help us keep the Senate and replace Manchin with a climate champion?](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaL7rDjQkL0BM84-ma7QEaVW9iBBRjyMcq4r6Ym_hhBC&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121423_cop28&n=2&v=5)**
---
| [](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaL7rDjQkL0BM84-ma7QEaVW9iBBRjyMcq4r6Ym_hhBC&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121423_cop28&n=3&v=5 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaL7rDjQkL0BM84-ma7QEaVW9iBBRjyMcq4r6Ym_hhBC&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121423_cop28&n=3&v=5)
---
The oil companies have their own plans to increase oil production. ExxonMobil and Chevron will increase spending significantly for this purpose in the next few years, and no law says they can't. The Inflation Reduction Act only provides carrots for renewables, not sticks for oil, gas, and coal. One observer at the conference said: "The U.S., in other words, would like the rest of the world to agree to do something it cannot possibly do itself. It is, by all accounts, planning to speed in the opposite direction, with no plans to place any limits on the companies leading that charge. You'd be forgiven for thinking this situation doesn't make sense because it doesn't." Unless U.S. political leaders are willing to use all their resources to clamp down on fossil fuel production and use, mere words of support for a phaseout of fossil fuel are meaningless. We are still the planet-wrecker-in-chief. I'm running for the U.S. Senate seat to replace retiring Joe Manchin because only with a new political leadership that understands what is at stake and has the guts to take action can we change the course of climate change.[**If you agree, please support our campaign today with a generous donation.**](https://www.shrewsburyforsenate.com/r?u=sTrCoaT-YmDhY88aC-xe_4EuiRHvEQu_OzjBiZlAGzs2u921EReiR88ARqrt5HWpbBPunnEofCMh9dr_AFzKQaL7rDjQkL0BM84-ma7QEaVW9iBBRjyMcq4r6Ym_hhBC&e=835c7faa13004566534194ac192acb50&utm_source=shrewsburyforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=121423_cop28&n=4&v=5) For our future, Zach Shrewsbury Candidate, U.S. Senate (D-WV)

# This was New(s) to us
---
We know it can become redundant when groups say that your vote matters and may feel like hyperbole. But, we keep seeing the life-changing impact that elections have on our lives, freedoms, and our children’s future. It’s on all of us to defend our democracy, and we’re dedicated to this work for the long haul! The recent elections will make an enormous difference in creating a supportive environment for kids and teachers in the Central Bucks School District. Check out [this video ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/Z_ZqkvoEVNEBXR4DaXxzv-ODJBPZbwwGPh5QtPNkgkoLG5_ZOiBlWD5FgorvOPQ37RVvZG_LQdawy-0F2YF5WyvO9-5iXSYqsZWAvZs3sanP8NZFXnJT-9KOG8jYP62RwB4TO1U6EYSv-ZR3dNZ8WWM2ci2DKcK_PUl308Q4AGz0RTTHjgqNpS0KmW8p29BW4HvJrMh8I4M_rqqX7t4MDNfG0VBjKxNetTjrU3DnMzcAdvJOQebEexrqNoscW8Q826VHxCRkvu2U-KEqe4lo8GL2NJ5pMQ4t8r2p3MSnjxV59Y75Lk5IvsSNpl4uQaAduTsq7ZUIASBenPqSd_XOvDh9bNok96bcMDMsT2MWWgDW7NFHnunlUPLGlUDYI1sbP-tql_Pl0ZN_w8jJOhusEQ/424/eN16tqk6SvW4G10OlPnMJA/h0/LucQIW4q2uoHHJVTszZf0PLdoxtR02U3XhfA8b6LBn8)of Karen Smith, the new Central Bucks School Board President, **getting sworn in by placing her hand on a stack of banned books**. It made our week! The new school board members made their mark right away by repealing and tabling policies passed by the previous school board. The repealed policies included a ban on books with “sexualized content,” the prohibition of transgender athletes playing sports, and a policy that prohibited teachers from talking about LGBTQ issues.
---
#### We’re also seeing first-hand why it’s necessary for Pennsylvania to elect state Supreme Court judges and officials who are pro-choice and will protect our freedoms.
---
[Texas:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDJE5ZArxNwvv1dX4bRMjSZK1YItH-o4gAMH4Cd40keGlAVtRXVU4so2cbZ2EINlICW90DobxVwElmVpLE5IhYwC1R_3mP_HXChZT10MwLrGTj4YdTcxXPVKv0lPgJL8IXeBmjw5A-__YnuTZT56bU8Cp2Chs84pxr0C4j9-4uPuoVIBitlkaB1knsXGjJSYto75zKpbk5R1WStoNjsvYWWUvz4WA7Q3UMHksCE8wqlDh4noFAJhMq22GB97-LqLgS9gs5FJ-jMM2dBiZIxpBSooZcUg7tssEV-5ba_JbaYFmFtMc3v5gWyhkedSKCqs2qEaZSJ0vhXxPajPIml0iZ2abO4ThEy0GqacDUXPpFgCU/424/eN16tqk6SvW4G10OlPnMJA/h1/Qp8FhSYcM44jDZiNfT4B2piGaP5gIid6fi8Op1TLI0M) Because of the abortion ban, after receiving a fatal fetal diagnosis with severe risks to her own health and future fertility, Kate Cox went to court for an emergency exception and it was granted. On Friday night, the Texas Supreme Court blocked that lower court ruling. Kate is currently 20 weeks pregnant and experiencing serious health complications. She is still fighting to receive abortion care. [New Hampshire:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDMFtjoYduL1DUlcCFDClUn6QYWu465Mvk-3UXdTBQD8dMNAPae_jx9aQMI7spm-P37aBKPqmRRg_9LTJzBJBEgw7F4otWbrFyvB7fPX95J6Z42x-ktreER-uFu3uWDTx6dP7ibpyo2ttRsVP8CE1wX8KJrB9lL46K2zoafZQ221kwVfHzOvNTvyLvkCZ7HgP8AYUFFJcafzI-HhZG81e6Flk8u8JjE-jdbcTuEzf7EfeWeUBTN-Y9RYmo8-jzEK_N5siEGAkHmYkaSLZKKKUV30FpIJeCbYr0CcdfqBgMO9ePGyYAWeO-dMhMpq050w-Bg/424/eN16tqk6SvW4G10OlPnMJA/h2/KYaV0vEOuLZXzryL6WPr364lwBizCWJyCCk-z6CBn4Q) Republican legislators are proposing a 15 day abortion ban. Yes, days. That’s before a pregnancy medically begins. In a state that is majority pro-choice, this would amount to a total abortion ban and is the most extreme ban proposed in the country. [Pennsylvania:](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDFM_bnXdock7zKjCKu4h10notkDepWlWBaYQiJULr6cRM1tmeFIrA7t8lfQfnd2TkpgHmewRNADj5tQ7BcjIdwEpqN-K8r7jon0q_012ObnZfXAcp1En8BmxKa5codDzJYSQKOuAXFHg7QzhS5s6EWhV39-yHW6yDv3d11u0UYR0paoOsDMpi4ZmNn_RdqS2mf3J6Wxd8qns1dF0X5OZ9J-V1Ca9G1K0823HsvJlatnj3__3_dYtRsn1A-YmsdpIyaybr6MqLQllQfSRCg4Vw9OBRrBC2cFwtn7h3tSX3R_Ql_BQbNQarxTKl_mminwFvOpX0zba0gMKYljQGlX5Y93K-ocXl_tHn-0lfioEJcM-167QA2t3DXHtHl9hUhTFMg/424/eN16tqk6SvW4G10OlPnMJA/h3/mApq886maWxOXHQ1sQJRGVT5yk4vIQEcLvJ3QSKEVvg) Now, in some hopeful news, the PA State Judiciary Committee heard testimony on Tuesday about House Bill 1888, which would create a ["'fundamental right to personal reproductive liberty,' in the state Constitution if voters approve."](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDFM_bnXdock7zKjCKu4h10notkDepWlWBaYQiJULr6cRM1tmeFIrA7t8lfQfnd2TkpgHmewRNADj5tQ7BcjIdwEpqN-K8r7jon0q_012ObnZfXAcp1En8BmxKa5codDzJYSQKOuAXFHg7QzhS5s6EWhV39-yHW6yDv3d11u0UYR0qGG3yOwTbzTXun6sBFi6kB9EdoMjYweSJTe-4aj81DJ9iD6yErPgiD9H9S2kEV0oyZiVSaDKG3h_hx7S2vPkphBXaJaNchLIHdHioGBWebOxxzbYK5x3MsysGE0HrKy78VAHuTBtGLB-M64DxIBJe4zT5wQOKr6ztlQZ_IZbOZTKbXww04GwB1zFB0sehGRlx0HOxBqA5XJrHhu9a-7IuA/424/eN16tqk6SvW4G10OlPnMJA/h4/bDjVAOL4B-22b9Umg7C8QOZJTjcfxdVwNYw4OHhLK0Y) It's a long process, and the earliest voters could decide isn't until 2025. Stay tuned for actions to take as it moves forward! Also, looking forward, this fall Pennsylvania youth turnout in the election for the 2023 Pa Supreme Court race [more than doubled on key college campuses](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDE-osrDsyUs4KS0eRiq-k7TsPfKHGHca47P4-hdri9Aq4DtgaoRMjlWgkdyRATg1HVMw5TxzW-PdfFWH7YndwAUMpX3RWWsebkUYDeSoavIjoteY7XP3cLDOkKnYuNBMKW5O9do664ltt1f44E4ljcXKLk_dMYyzMDuKotom1wLuhr9C69K8Lz5yvRMCr-j-TCmTujqomZsWGQYKGgY3MWiXMXSbOtbj5Qps7WrH6MfbSdML55FM7uko07jFCS4Bzg/424/eN16tqk6SvW4G10OlPnMJA/h5/HaOCSAJaZeQF4wtF4MxkdeSsZU4hD2PoP_SGZv3ZKUU) throughout Pennsylvania when compared to the last time there was an open seat on the bench. Temple University saw a 563% increase in turnout between 21 and 23. Gen Z has political power and they’re showing up!

body:
The attacks keep coming on critical voting rights legislation. | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/75180802/443863167/765663662?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRlAvMS84NTQ3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZDE1YjFiMi1iYzlhLWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjNmMzYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GFmnqOyFamcGGBB15Jzf9L2atYLlv5InRJiM8d9-Uc4=&emci=b8d64fef-d599-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&emdi=ed15b1b2-bc9a-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&ceid=561582) | Team, The Voting Rights Act (VRA) is a landmark piece of legislation that was passed in 1965, which finally pushed for fair voting rights under the 15th Amendment. And ever since its inception, it has been under constant attack. From Supreme Court decisions to a recent federal appeals court ruling that prevents private citizens from being able to file lawsuits to enforce the VRA, ultra-conservatives are pulling apart this vital piece of legislation limb by limb. As people continue to be empowered to show up to the polls and use their voices, we don’t anticipate these attacks stopping anytime soon. [**That’s why we have to be prepared to fight against these attacks on democracy. Fellow American, **Never in a million years did I think it was going to end like it did.**_****_

This was the biggest toss-up Congressional race in America. We worked day in & day out. We knocked on thousands of doors & talked to hundreds of thousands of voters- but we came up a few votes short & I was forced to concede the election in 2018.

We had left everything on the field that had already been soaked with our blood, our sweat, and now our tears. Losing that first election was the toughest pill I’ve ever had to swallow, but I knew there was still work to be done and I wasn’t ready to quit. **EVERYONE expected me to just walk away – the “experts” in the media said there was no way I could run & win again.**

But my parents fled the Communist rule in Cuba & came to America with just five bucks in their pockets & the dream of a better life.

They taught me to love this country with everything that I have & to fight for what I believe in. So I picked myself up by the bootstraps like every other conservative in America.

And I put my name back on the ballot in the biggest race in the nation.

But this time, I was running against a well-funded & far left radical Democrat. With the help of proud conservative patriots like you, I went on to deliver Joe Biden & Nancy Pelosi the most humiliating political upset in America- narrowly winning this major swing district by just a few points. But before I was even sworn in, the Democrat machine was up & running like never before & the money from Hollywood & Wall Street was flowing in at rates nobody has ever seen before.

That’s why I’m humbly asking for your help today- can I count on your support to defend this seat & deliver back to back comeback wins against Joe Biden?

| | Peter — We deserve to live our lives free from the fear of gun violence, and I'm fighting to create this future for all Texans. **[I ask you to join me in the stand against gun violence by making a donation toward my campaign's $15,000 mid-month goal>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/75181342/443864716/1416552317?refcode=em23_231214_MM2GR_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_231214_MM2GR_fnd_gq_act___DBW_ettx&utm_medium=email&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&firstname=Peter&lastname=&zip=&refcode2=f80baaf6-bd9a-ee11-bea1-002248223f36&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDU5MjMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjgwYmFhZjYtYmQ5YS1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzZjM2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=QWqyxE0uEJGClz-ZzZxVdM2esAQ_xBPeFe21hbmJr9E=)**

As a trauma surgeon, I’ve pronounced too many children dead from gun violence, delivered devastating news to far too many families, and spent too many hours treating gunshot victims in the trauma bay.

**This carnage must stop — it's time for change.**

Throughout my career, I've dedicated myself to both medical and legislative efforts to curb the devastating impact of gun violence. In 2022, I played a crucial role in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, working with Democratic leaders to extend background checks, support red flag laws, and address the "boyfriend loophole."

**If elected to Congress, I will be a fierce advocate for comprehensive gun safety reforms.** Here are the key measures I will champion:
* **Reinstate the Assault Weapons Ban:** I experienced firsthand training with military-grade weapons, and I know that assault weapons have no place in the hands of untrained civilians or on our streets.
* **Raise the Minimum Age to Purchase Firearms to 21:** Firearms are a leading cause of death for those aged 18-20, and raising the age for all weapon purchases is a straightforward solution to save lives.
* **Universal Background Checks:** Ensure that all gun purchases undergo thorough background checks, closing loopholes and promoting responsible ownership.
* **Invest in Community Violence Prevention Programs:** Particularly in historically impoverished and underrepresented communities impacted by structural racism, we need to invest in programs that address the root causes of violence.
* **National Red Flag Law:** Implement a national red flag law to keep guns out of the hands of individuals who pose a threat to themselves or others.

These measures are crucial steps toward ending the epidemic of gun violence – and I am ready to go to Washington to fight for all of them. But to get there, I need your help. **[Will you make a donation to my campaign? clean_body: | | Peter — We deserve to live our lives free from the fear of gun violence, and I'm fighting to create this future for all Texans. = As a trauma surgeon, I’ve pronounced too many children dead from gun violence, delivered devastating news to far too many families, and spent too many hours treating gunshot victims in the trauma bay. This carnage must stop — it's time for change. Throughout my career, I've dedicated myself to both medical and legislative efforts to curb the devastating impact of gun violence. In 2022, I played a crucial role in the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, working with Democratic leaders to extend background checks, support red flag laws, and address the "boyfriend loophole." If elected to Congress, I will be a fierce advocate for comprehensive gun safety reforms. Here are the key measures I will champion: Reinstate the Assault Weapons Ban: I experienced firsthand training with military-grade weapons, and I know that assault weapons have no place in the hands of untrained civilians or on our streets. Raise the Minimum Age to Purchase Firearms to 21: Firearms are a leading cause of death for those aged 18-20, and raising the age for all weapon purchases is a straightforward solution to save lives. Universal Background Checks: Ensure that all gun purchases undergo thorough background checks, closing loopholes and promoting responsible ownership. Invest in Community Violence Prevention Programs: Particularly in historically impoverished and underrepresented communities impacted by structural racism, we need to invest in programs that address the root causes of violence. National Red Flag Law: Implement a national red flag law to keep guns out of the hands of individuals who pose a threat to themselves or others. These measures are crucial steps toward ending the epidemic of gun violence – and I am ready to go to Washington to fight for all of them. As an avid outdoorsman, he vigorously defends the Second Amendment. He is passionate about mentoring young people and serves as the head coach of his local high school basketball team.

Gov. Justice and his wife, First Lady Cathy Justice, have been best friends since high school. They recently celebrated their 46th wedding anniversary. The Governor and the First Lady have two adult children and spend time spoiling four grandchildren. In addition, they have three dogs: Lucy and Ellie, Boston Terriers, and their famous Babydog, an English Bulldog.

clean_body: | | If you want to help The Collective PAC build Black political power up and down the ballot, and across the country, then you’re in the right place. If you'd like to unsubscribe | | Peter, I wanted to reach out to talk about 2024. This next election cycle is a critical test of our collective strength. Winning in 2024 means electing a Black woman to the US Senate, beating far-right extremists like Ted Cruz and Ron DeSantis , and uplifting Black Democrats up and down the ballot. Losing in 2024 to a fascist like Donald Trump would spell disaster — and quite literally an end to democracy as we know it. That’s why I’m reaching out now to talk about our end-of-year push. We’ve set an ambitious goal to raise $50,000 by December 31 at midnight — and it’s going to take all of our grassroots supporters stepping up and chipping in to get there. When you invest in The Collective PAC, your dollars go straight to work uplifting the next generation of Black Democratic elected officials and voters. Some of the money we raise goes towards registering voters, providing free rideshares to and from polling locations, and contacting voters. The rest goes straight to our Democratic candidates. If we fall short of this goal, we can’t register as many voters, and our candidates lose out on the resources they need to compete. In an election as competitive as 2024, and with the stakes this high, hitting our $50,000 goal could be the difference between winning the majority and losing to a fascist like Donald Trump. We have a choice to make: Do we fight as hard as humanly possible to elect champions like Barbara Lee, Colin Allred, Angela Alsobrooks , and Lisa Blunt Rochester? Or do we roll over to extremist Republicans who have called us vermin and are gutting voting rights across the country? | If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately. | | | | | | It’s your investment in our work that allows us to be successful. As always, I couldn’t be more grateful for your endless commitment to building Black political power. Quentin James President and Co-Founder of The Collective PAC The Collective PAC is strategically focused on creating a truly equitable democracy where our nation’s local, state and federal governments have diverse and talented elected leadership and Black people are fully represented in positions of power to create the policies necessary to progress our communities forward. That’s why she was one of the first members of Congress to call for a ceasefire in Gaza and has been advocating and organizing with her colleagues for an end to this bloodshed which has already killed over 17,000 Palestinians. She took this risk knowing that it would result in pro-war groups like AIPAC spending up MILLIONS to oust her. And now she’s part of the group of progressive incumbents facing challengers solely because of her stance on valuing the humanity of both Palestinians and Israelis alike. This isn’t the first time we’ve seen Republican billionaire-funded Super PACs pour money against outspoken progressives. Our grassroots movement has overcome millions in special interests and super PAC spending before and we can do it again. It’s been clear to all of us since AIPAC announced their intention to recruit challengers against Cori and the squad that whoever was going to run against Cori in 2024 would have millions of dollars in support from Republican mega-donors. The same donors who gave to Trump and the insurrectionist Republicans who have threatened our democracy time and time again. These pro-war PACs and the right-wing billionaires bankrolling them care about one thing and one thing only: punishing anyone who dares speak up for the humanity of Palestinians. Let’s be clear: Cori will never back down from advocating for Palestinian human and civil rights. Cori was elected by the people to serve the interests of all the people, not just the ultra-wealthy, hawk-ish few. And the vast majority of Democrats in this country want a ceasefire now. They do not want our tax dollars to continue to go towards mass Palestinian death. Cori will continue to advocate for peace, for an end to this violence, and for full equality, not just because that’s what the majority of the population wants, but because that is the right thing to do. body:
Expanding and strengthening our volunteer program is something that we’re prioritizing in December and we could really use your help.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/130?refcode=em20231214&t=1&akid=707%2E62735%2EleiADo)
We’re a grassroots campaign, Peter. And a key aspect of that means building support from the ground up for Hill Harper.
We need to consistently build and strengthen our momentum — until it can bring us all the way to Washington.
**One of the most important ways to achieve that is by having a robust and extensive volunteer program.**
[**Can you help support our invaluable volunteer program by chipping in $5 or whatever you can afford right now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231214?amount=5&refcode=em20231214-707&refcode2=707_62735_leiADo&akid=707%2E62735%2EleiADo)

To ensure that our volunteer program not only continues running but is able to expand we need the resources to pay for crucial campaign supplies that often get forgotten about.
Things like water, pizza, snacks, gas, etc. help our volunteers stay fueled as well as able to get to the communities they need to reach out to.
To win this race, we need to have as many supporters as possible out in neighborhoods and counties across Michigan knocking on doors and getting out the vote.
**Your donation today will go directly to supporting our volunteer recruitment, training, canvassing, and door-knocking efforts.**
[**So what do you say? Can you chip in $5 or anything you can right now?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/hh-em-20231214?amount=5&refcode=em20231214-707&refcode2=707_62735_leiADo&akid=707%2E62735%2EleiADo)

Team Hill Harper

Dear Vivek Ramaswamy Volunteers,

We are running out of time!

I hope this email finds you all in good health and enjoying the Christmas and Holiday Season. With 32 days to the Iowa Caucus and 40 days to the NH Primary, we are headed into crunch time.

Vivek is doing his part. He is feverishly traveling both states doing town halls, spreading the Truth and listening to voters' concerns. You can feel the momentum on the ground!

We are excited to announce an important event coming up this Saturday that we are calling "Super Saturday" - a day dedicated to making a significant impact on the upcoming elections through voter contact door knocks and calls.

As passionate supporters, you have been critical in our campaign's success so far. Your dedication, support, and hard work have helped us engage with voters, spread our message, and build a strong army of support. Now, as we approach the crucial phase of the elections, we need your continued support to ensure our success.

Super Saturday will be a day of collective efforts, where we will come together as a team to reach out to voters in our community. By making door knocks and calls, we can personally connect with voters, address their concerns, and encourage them to exercise their right to vote. These personal interactions have proven to be highly effective in mobilizing voters and making a real difference.

Here are the details for Super Saturday:
**Sign up** [**here**](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=2554d873e5084419aa9abaf125f11728&_e=Y6h1P_hJJPp_HpvXCGTTmRzNj66cvQQo9l3j7Tj3St1i6XSczgyLe1og5ZH4bQSiBdZPLGB066UcuVIY9ZkAW80y4LvIRTvx30VKl-U59cg8aT4VprokR3X8ECGfyX89c1qQyIgF5lMEwu_CXUpVo6VnAf1rgCca4gMeghi8ZN60grQb3b8wEPwBw180iiSm_J_E2KSA42hC6M3nbCbJpsg2mQmXKM_wuZTuVvsdGBc%3D)
**Date:** Saturday, December 16th
**Time:** 12 p.m. Eastern/9 a.m. Pacific
**Location:** Please sign up [**here**](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=2554d873e5084419aa9abaf125f11728&_e=Y6h1P_hJJPp_HpvXCGTTmRzNj66cvQQo9l3j7Tj3St1i6XSczgyLe1og5ZH4bQSipefa0smkx3_O-PArLwWPYUUzhPLK70BKnlQtDqCUDlQxQ5XM-XE5Uday-uTc7vdtKajzmZctPGQy9TkKw45B6gluTUiWkEUEIXKN2bggIp0IY2BDgIvJZoPbpnxqBSUVLkFySv2PFV3rbeTuMFiG8nzGig4K-cfBuKlWfWk3Y34%3D) so we can get you a Campaign Sidekick account that will make it easy for you to call voters in IA and NH -- from the comfort of your home anywhere in the U.S.
We will start the day with a brief training session to provide you with the necessary information and resources. Our team leaders will guide you through the process, ensuring that you are well-prepared and confident in your voter outreach efforts. Whether you are an experienced volunteer or new to the campaign, your participation is invaluable.

[**Please RSVP here to confirm your attendance.**](http://links.vivek2024.com/u/click?_t=07471d1165224e98aee1aca8cd71f6e2&_m=2554d873e5084419aa9abaf125f11728&_e=Y6h1P_hJJPp_HpvXCGTTmRzNj66cvQQo9l3j7Tj3St1i6XSczgyLe1og5ZH4bQSiAEApFrRpIUKbfR0FgQpM44Yc0peD9-b3PkAvI8OopXd2vpyWv4tvBcOAkNfEpDFpSdXvm06UwIfFPtZGPqYjlrReIIrXdTu836gFg7YgzzRnf-Makybqb3lnx6rgACyXxr_IvkrDERH2IoXdWvMbdrQQaVmpyWhbCCoLVwqwE4M%3D) This will help us plan and organize the event effectively. If you have any specific preferences or requirements, please let us know, and we will do our best to accommodate them.

Remember, every conversation counts, and each door knock or call brings us closer to our goal. Your efforts can make a significant impact on the outcome of the elections and help shape the future of our country.

Thank you for your unwavering support and dedication. Together we can win! We look forward to seeing you on Super Saturday!

Best Regards,

Team Vivek

**GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

He has been a prominent and outspoken critic against ESG, discriminatory practices under the guise of critical race theory, and of what he calls "government-tech censorship," where the government colludes with big tech to do through the backdoor what it couldn't do through the front door under the Constitution.

Vivek is a first-generation American. Growing up in the Cincinnati area, he often recounts the sage advice he received from his father that "If you're going to stand out, then you might as well be outstanding." This advice set the course for his life: an accomplished pianist, a nationally ranked tennis player, and the valedictorian of his Jesuit high school. He went on to graduate summa cum laude in Biology from Harvard in 2007 and received his J.D. degree from Yale Law School in 2013, worked at a hedge fund, then started a pharmaceutical company, Roivant Sciences, where his team developed five drugs that went on to become FDA-approved.

In 2022, he founded Strive Asset Management, an Ohio-based firm, that takes direct aim at asset managers like BlackRock, State Street, Vanguard and others for their fiduciary breach of duty to maximize the wealth of their clients for Wokeism. Strive's mission is to restore the voices of everyday citizens in the American economy by leading companies to focus on excellence over politics.

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

We’re facing a crisis of confidence. Congressional job approval is the lowest [https://news.gallup.com/poll/513410/congress-job-approval-drops-lowest-2017.aspx] it’s been since 2017, the Supreme Court remains out of touch with modern-day life, and people feel that they are being left behind by the people elected to represent them.

Americans want real change in Washington. And to make that happen, we need to strike at the root of dysfunction–Big Money and corporate lobbying.

That’s why I’ve introduced a bold, comprehensive anti-corruption plan to ensure elected officials put people and country first. This plan will ban all PAC and lobbyist money from Congress; ban members of Congress from trading stocks; enact term limits for members of Congress and Supreme Court Justices; and ban members of Congress from ever becoming lobbyists.

https://act.rokhanna.com/a/political-reform-platform-petition?contactdata=M3ApIqdgzSq82WuUR9MR/oNglKSXF/O03e3jaUb4bqTVINm8QxxclirmD3DqWM0BGBn6dNx0PZ142/IR+zYhMgnR2eXCpr/7FJJuEJTZTiXIx5Dx4+8zSiij2jPvvps8hWJb8qipchdHy4VIOHx8kA== [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/political-reform-platform-petition?contactdata=M3ApIqdgzSq82WuUR9MR/oNglKSXF/O03e3jaUb4bqTVINm8QxxclirmD3DqWM0BGBn6dNx0PZ142/IR+zYhMgnR2eXCpr/7FJJuEJTZTiXIx5Dx4+8zSiij2jPvvps8hWJb8qipchdHy4VIOHx8kA==]

Thank you for your activism and all that you do. Together we can move our country forward.

Onward,
Ro

clean_body: As your new Speaker, getting Yvette back in Congress with us is among my top electoral priorities. | | Fellow patriot, When Yvette Herrell was first elected to Congress in 2020, both New Mexicans and Republicans in the House gained a fierce and dedicated fighter for conservative principles and American exceptionalism. Then, Democrats gerrymandered this district in their favor and managed to flip the seat by just one point! When this happened, not only did we lose what Yvette brought to Congress, but we were saddled with the polar opposite in her opponent. This will once again be among the very most competitive races in 2024, and with our majority as slim as it is, winning this seat back will be critical to governing and getting our country back on track going forward. As your new Speaker, getting Yvette back in Congress with us is among my top electoral priorities. Thanks for stepping up for this top-priority race. Mike Johnson Speaker of the House | Born and raised in New Mexico, Yvette Herrell served for 4 terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. Kat Cammack is serving her second term representing the people of Northeastern Florida in Congress. She won the seat on a conservative platform of growing jobs, securing our southern border, standing up for law enforcement, defending our Second Amendment, promoting fiscal responsibility, and defending life.
Congresswoman Cammack sits on the House Committee on Energy and Commerce and House Committee on Agriculture, where she is the only Florida Republican serving the Sunshine State's farmers, ranchers, and producers. She was also appointed to the Select Subcommittee on the Weaponization of the Federal Government.
Kat and her husband Matt, who is a firefighter, paramedic, and SWAT medic, proudly call Gainesville, Florida home.

body:
The border crisis is far worse than I imagined.

Hey there - did you see Max's email? We know it's a busy time of year!

Max went down to the border last week to meet with Border Patrol and check out the border crisis for himself. It's worse than he imagined.

Check out the video below or click here and see for yourself! (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=FWD_Border_Video_Donate_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=eb30b91d48-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Max is fired up. People need to see for themselves what's really going on down at the border.

- Team Max Ukropina

----------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Max Ukropina
Subject: I Toured the Border. Here's What I Saw.
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Peter, I went down to the southern border last week in San Diego with my team to learn firsthand about the border crisis on the front lines.

We met with Border Patrol. We toured the wall. We watched as over a dozen migrants illegally entered the U.S. in a matter of minutes.

The conclusion: this border crisis is far worse than I imagined. Any candidate who isn't talking about this issue simply isn't serious.

We put together a video documenting what we saw and what we learned. I want to share it with you because the situation is far more serious than the media makes it seem. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=FWD_Border_Video_Donate_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=eb30b91d48-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

I hope you have a few minutes to watch it. (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=FWD_Border_Video_Donate_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=eb30b91d48-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Now I have to ask ... if you liked the video, can you donate just $25 TODAY to help us make sure as many voters as possible see this ad? (https://secure.anedot.com/max-ukropina-for-congress-2024/border-security-contribute?utm_medium=Email&utm_source=Ukropina&utm_campaign=FWD_Border_Video_Donate_121323&utm_source=Max+for+OC+Supporters&utm_campaign=eb30b91d48-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_24_03_09_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-f436e3f042-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Our visit to the border was eye-opening. We toured a 50-yard gap in the border wall where anyone can easily walk through.

In fact, we watched over a dozen people do it in just the few minutes we were there.

We need to finish the wall and invest in border security. But the hard reality is that the border crisis is being caused by smugglers and cartels taking advantage of our country’s broken asylum laws.

This crisis won’t end until we overhaul those laws.

Congress needs to act immediately to tighten our asylum laws in three ways:
* Prohibit migrants claiming asylum unless they do so through a port of entry.
* Tighten screening to ensure illegitimate claims don’t get through.
* Improve the courts to decrease asylum claimants wait times to days, not years

Until we change our laws, the border will always be overwhelmed with people trying to get in.

These are the kind of common-sense, America First policies I plan to vocally fight for in Congress. Our leaders have gotten us into this mess.

If they aren't willing to change the laws, then it's time to change our leaders.

If you agree with me, please chip in whatever you can contribute TODAY to help us win this election. Our problems are solvable if we elect leaders with the resolve to solve them. Talk soon,

Max Ukropina

| Dear Friends,

Exciting news! This Saturday, December 16th at 10am Dutchess County will be unveiling the new & improved Northside Line Urban Trail. AND, making a special announcement.

As County Executive, I was so proud to have a hand in making this project a reality. The trail will feature lighting for 24-hour use, be plowed as necessary in the winter, and maybe even have a new name!

You'll have to come by to find out!

**_Details are below: _**
**WHO: **Congressman Marc Molinaro, Dutchess County Executive William F.X. O’Neil, local elected officials, community leaders, and representatives from Scenic Hudson, Marist College and more.

**WHAT:** Soft Opening & Special Dedication of the Northside Line Urban Trail

**WHERE:** The event will take place near Parker Avenue where the Northside Line connects with WRS Dutchess Rail Trail entrance trail in the City of Poughkeepsie. Parking is available across Parker Avenue at the former Veith electric building.

Fellow American, you may know me as the new Speaker of the House, but at the end of the day,_I’m still just a dad from Louisiana._

Here is what you need to know: I am a steadfast believer in our Lord and Savior, a husband to my incredible wife Kelly, and father to four wonderful kids. I come to DC week in and week out to fight for their futures and the future of our country.

When people ask Kelly and I why we keep going and why we are still compelled to serve in public office, our answer is simple: “This is for our children. For ALL of our children and grandchildren.”

Part of this new role is asking folks like you to make donations so that we can be successful in our effort to grow the majority. I’m not quite used to this part of the job yet, but I’ll get there because I care so deeply for the cause we are fighting for. **I want to hand down to our kids the freest, most thriving version of our country so they have a chance to live out the American dream.**

[**If you share that vision with me, Fellow American, could you watch this video I recorded for you and then commit to a donation today?**](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=849018c013e14062a96d05478480895a&_e=bFqc7qT-n4GKVXs-VeTQn-1Qz1HRSi5JikodKKeMTTkAbaz5fY3_yhHrRnX7TWZ6r8S01aIUke8sCNOUQBbLzzLUqG-3FvPbdg23xkAo8JPhFudoHHGASJcn_1Hw5Stjdj-GCR2aENShiwatWJaCl0xqbo0PDDlYgfb5JqYFxkBmQcSu-tZ2zkJwhEtIz0DeFy9LXg0ltPCgTX1Im7KeIn3tiZc6CkDZ8q7DFUjeX4JefnCOxR5xVmsoSLEZ7FxtocCIPs8nDs_kp4uXYjHqqtsmTaAOHwJLVVJNRnFfxjwKpLl9w-FjW7yNGMt69pVnW2Vo1GA6yKwqrTgRe9AhZms-zgoUyjDL8LHAAI-5JdrrItG_x_UHx0M172TpzV2oZzOAyl14rQ5zaEGN-tbmeR-05WzvhA43qCw4Bjm0VFg%3D)

Jocelyn

name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: The DeVos family is all-in on Mike Rogers:
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=910%2E135344%2EwVhl5M)

Friends --
As Michiganders know, for decades the DeVos family’s #1 issue has been weakening Michigan's, and the country's, public education system. Betsy DeVos used Michigan as her petri dish before becoming Trump’s Secretary of Education, and his longest serving cabinet secretary.
The DeVos family has supported opponents of mine in the past, and it looks like they’re ready to double down on this Senate race.
**Republican Mike Rogers' latest FEC report was filled with donations from a bunch of members of the DeVos family -- contributions totaling $46,200 all made on one single day, just before the September 30th deadline.**
Mike Rogers has already started to see a flood of support from deep-pocketed Republican donors like Betsy DeVos, corporate PACs, and Super PACs who will all spend millions of dollars on his behalf in order to flip Michigan red. In 2020, the DeVos family contributed over $1.6 million to candidates and PACs which have spent over $10 million to super PACs to influence races like ours.
So these contributions are just the beginning of the support Mike Rogers will receive from this powerful family.
But this campaign has something Mike Rogers' campaign lacks: lots and lots of regular people giving what they can, when they can.
Just one peek behind-the-curtain of Mike Rogers' FEC report shows he raised less than 5% of his money from individuals making small-dollar donations.
By contrast, the majority of the donations we receive come from people contributing significantly smaller donations than the DeVos family made to Mike Rogers: Our average email donation was $26 last quarter.
And what you may not know is that the single greatest source of individual donations to our campaign is the response to emails like this.
That’s why I would love to earn your support today. [**Your help using this link to make a $3 contribution to my campaign for United States Senate would be a great rebuke to the DeVos support.](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-dec23.ZG_uWI&refcode=em231214-2-tt&t=2&akid=910%2E135344%2EwVhl5M)**

| I have big plans for the future. To restore and rebuild trust in our democracy. To build an economy that works for us all. To increase access to affordable health care and reduce student loan debt for people across our country.

Derek —
We’re just 17 days from our final FEC deadline of the year — and the final one of this primary election cycle, to boot.
**[Before I explain why this deadline is so important to our campaign, will you pitch in $3?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=dec2023_abs_em.181qVM&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_MMG_AC90_20231214_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=3&t=5&akid=4759%2E5257348%2Ef60B_8)**
Our March 5 Senate primary will be here before we know it. Early voting sites open and ballots get sent in the mail even sooner. We have limited time to reach California’s 22 million voters.
We rely on this grassroots team, not corporate PACs, to fuel our campaign. Everyone from our leading GOP opponent Steve Garvey to the California GOP to national pundits and reporters will be looking at our FEC report to see the strength of our campaign.
They are going to pore over the numbers and try to determine for themselves if we have the ability to win. Or they might start to wonder if we’ll falter and fall short of making it to the Senate General Election.
**Derek, I’m ready to bring bold change to the Senate. To restore and rebuild trust in our democracy. To abolish the filibuster and finally codify abortion access. To build an economy that works for us all. To increase access to affordable health care and reduce student loan debt for people across the country.**
But all of these plans, and more, are contingent on us winning in March and then again in November — and I can only do that with you by my side.

name: Kirsten Engel
subject: Gun safety laws
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Engel for Arizona
body:
https://www.engelforarizona.com/ [https://www.engelforarizona.com/]
Peter,
The scariest call I’ve ever received was from my daughter on the day that her school went into lockdown.
She called me while crouched under her desk. There were reports of a person with a gun on school property, and she didn’t know what was going to happen. It was terrifying .

clean_body: More than a few boats and a few roads | | | | The little things make all the difference when it comes to the historic Bipartisan Infrastructure Law. Do not look wholly at the $660 billion and the vital rebuilding of America it will fund; consider instead the Snohomish River Bridge, in Everett. The bridge carries traffic into Everett's downtown core as part of State Route 529. It is unambiguously a major piece of how people get around. Thanks to the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law passed two years ago, Washington's Department of Transportation is able to specifically rehabilitate the Snohomish River Bridge. That is important, both as a means of moving people and as a job creator. Or, how about another example, a multimodal bridge over I-5 for our friends and neighbors in Lynnwood — which, again, will create jobs and give a boost to Lynnwood's accessible transportation system. Friends, while this is not strictly about a bridge here, a ferry or port upgrade there, it is precisely why a functioning Congress is so crucial. This is so, so many jobs and vital improvements for communities here in Northwest Washington. When Congress breaks down into chaos and squabbles, as we have seen repeatedly since Republicans took charge after the 2022 election, projects like this do not get done. Quite the opposite, in fact: they are shoved deep on the back-burner while ridiculous conspiracies are thrust to the forefront. The results are quite clear: when Democrats are in charge of major policy decisions like these, the American people see tremendous returns. And, specifically, so too are the people of Northwest Washington. That is exactly why I am going to campaign as hard as I can in 2024. Because, as you see, elections absolutely have consequences. Hello,
The day before the anniversary of the Supreme Court’s disastrous _Dobbs_ decision, I woke up to Fox News and Lauren Boebert attacking my sister and my 81-year-old father.
For decades, Dad was an OB-GYN. He delivered thousands of babies and wrote books on how to get pregnant and to navigate menopause. Dad provided women with full access to all kinds of reproductive health care, including abortions, in the years right after _Roe_ – and he has now had to watch as women’s reproductive rights are gutted in the aftermath of _Dobbs_.
Dad and his clinic faced many threats over the years. It’s no exaggeration to say that he put his own safety – and that of his family – at risk in order to protect the rights of women to make their own medical decisions.
But I’m not sure he ever expected to see a sitting member of Congress attacking him – or my sister who followed in his footsteps – in a national news outlet. **It’s disgusting. These kinds of personal attacks against my family have no place in our politics and do nothing to serve the people of Western and Southern Colorado.**
If Lauren Boebert wants to have a conversation about reproductive rights in this country, I am more than happy to have that debate. We can talk about how I support _freedom_ and _liberty_ – and how she supports big government intruding into the lives of women. We can talk about how Boebert supports a national ban on abortion – with no exceptions for rape, incest, or the life of the mother. And we can talk about how Lauren Boebert is so extreme, she even wants to ban the pill that’s been used by women for decades.
I am willing to talk all day about Lauren Boebert’s fringe view that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions. **But what I won’t accept is Lauren Boebert and Fox News attacking my father and my sister.**
I am _incredibly_ proud of my father. He provided health care to women when they needed it during some of the happiest – and most devastating – moments of their lives. Before retirement, he would drive two hours to Planned Parenthood and help teach the next generation of health care providers, like my sister. And no one – not Fox News, and especially not Lauren Boebert – is going to stop my family from continuing to stand up for a woman’s right to choose.
**Lauren Boebert is scared. Last year, I came just 546 votes shy of defeating her and ending her political career once and for all. I’m ready to finish the job in 2024, but these are the kinds of ugly attacks that I’m already up against.**

| Peter,

My dad was a dedicated public servant and proud union member. **He instilled in me, above all else, the importance of hard work and the responsibility we share to care for one another.**

I made it my mission to be the most pro-labor Lands Chief I could, and I'm proud of the historic progress we've made. From expanding workforce development through education and training programs to expanding new industries like sustainable timber and leasing out public land for what will be our largest solar farm ever, we invested in the success of hard-working Washingtonians.

I couldn’t be more grateful to have the support of pro-labor organizations like _Grays Harbor Professional Firefighters IAFF Local 3390, LIUNA Local 252, Olympic Peninsula Building & Construction Trades Council, Teamsters Joint Council 28, West Pierce Fire Fighters IAFF Local 1488, and the Washington Fire Chiefs._

Now, I'm running for Congress to bring the bold progress we've created here to the other Washington. Too many families in the 6th Congressional District face the same burdens – those challenges extend far beyond our state's borders.

Hey Peter — thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important.

**You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place.** Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an _even greater_ and _more long-term threat_ \- **hopelessness.**

When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work.

I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better.

**We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan.** A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them.

For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business.

**The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers.** The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate.

**We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation.**

Here’s our plan:
* Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures.
* Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win.
* And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN.

Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve.

**But what we do _right now_ will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass.** We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country.

* * *

If you'd like to unsubscribe | | Hey Peter — thanks for opening this email. I know a lot is going on, so I appreciate it. It’s a little long, but it’s from the heart, and it’s important. You don’t have to be obsessed with politics or watching the news 24/7 to know our country is in a bad place. Horrific violence in the Middle East. A Republican Party that has gone so far off the rails they could barely elect a Speaker. The leading Republican candidate for president is Donald Trump! And then we have unspeakable atrocities like the mass shooting in Maine because our “leaders” refuse to act. And many people talk about how Trump is a major threat to democracy and he is — but I believe there is an even greater and more long-term threat \- hopelessness. When I was knocking doors for Leaders We Deserve-endorsed candidate Nadarius Clark for the Virginia elections, the most concerning answer I got when I asked if people were voting was, “No, I don’t believe in voting” or “No all politics is corrupt and my vote doesn’t matter.” This scares me because things can never get better if we continue electing people who say “government doesn't work” who then get elected and make it not work. I’m deeply worried about us. And it’s not because I’m anti-America. It’s because I love this country and I desperately want to see us do better. We’re not going to fix this mess overnight. But we do have a plan. A group of us just launched Leaders We Deserve. We started it because we know that young progressive leaders can change the future of this country for the better by giving us what we need most to get through this moment of democratic backsliding, HOPE. We can elect more young leaders like Nadarius Clark, but we can ONLY do it if enough of us get behind them. For us to give the school shooting generation the hope it needs to secure the future of our democracy and build a more perfect union, we must get to work electing the next generation of morally just leaders who put kids first and the NRA out of business. The truth is that young progressive candidates who are running for office face huge barriers. The average age of our elected officials is astronomical. That’s because our election system favors those who are older, wealthy, and white. In 2020, Millennial and Gen-Z individuals only held 21% of State Legislative seats despite representing 45% of the electorate. We launched Leaders We Deserve specifically to coalesce support from millions of Americans who believe in the promise of this younger generation. Here’s our plan: Find young progressives who are willing to run for Congress and state legislatures. Equip their campaigns with messaging, scheduling, and budget tools they need to win. And most importantly, raise funds from our massive national network (hey, that’s you!) to allow them to go toe-to-toe with their opponents and WIN. Peter, if we succeed, ten years from now we’ll have shifted the politics of this nation dramatically. Young, progressive leaders will make up their fair share of the legislative and congressional seats, allowing us to right the ship and build the future we deserve. But what we do right now will determine whether or not that vision comes to pass. We can’t just muddle along raising a couple hundred thousand dollars here and there. We’ll actually have to raise tens of millions of dollars from grassroots donors like you to get the breadth and scale we need to win in all corners of the country. Here’s what I need from you for our plan to work. – If you are blessed with the financial ability to make a really big donation (like $500 or more), please do so right now to help us make this vision a reality. – If you can give a small donation each month, that makes a big impact too. – If you can’t give big and you can’t give monthly, that’s totally OK (most people can’t). – Last but not least, if you can’t chip in at all, I completely understand. All I ask is that you forward this email to three friends who might be aligned with our cause. I hope this fundraiser is as successful as I know it can be. I hope that we look back at this moment in ten years and say THIS is when everything started to change. Peter,

Last cycle, the support of our EMILYs List community helped Democrats defend the Senate majority, win critical governorships, _and_ secure must-win seats in major state & local races across the country. The secret to our success? Sustained commitment from pro-choice voters and activists like _you_ , Peter.

Now, we're facing even higher-stakes races in 2024.

EMILYs List was founded on the mission of electing Democratic pro-choice women to office. Our founder, Ellen Malcom, built a millions-strong community of individuals who pledged to support our candidates _all cycle long_. Because of their long-term investment, EMILYs List members have been central to the success of Democratic pro-choice women in tough races up and down the ballot.

That's why, nearly four decades later, our annual members remain at the forefront of our strategy and victories every election cycle. That's also why I'm reaching out directly today, Peter, on the _final day_ of our Early Bird membership drive.

body:
I thought it was important that I touch base with you.
#

Friends — with our mid-month deadline just around the corner, I thought it was important that I touch base with you.
We set pretty high goals because we’ve got a lot on the agenda this year. Whether it’s supporting the Arizona Democratic Party, traveling and fundraising for friends in tough races, delivering for the people of Arizona, or finding time to hang out with my granddaughter Sage... the schedule has been packed.
And all of the sudden, we’ve got just over two weeks until the end of the year. That makes two weeks until our final FEC fundraising deadline of 2023, too. It will fly by.
Every month so far, this team has stepped up. We’ve consistently hit our goals. We’ll make you proud when we report out everything we’ve raised this year — and when the GOP establishment in Washington sees what we’ve been able to do for candidates in tough races around the country.
So, with that final deadline coming up, I need your help one more time.
[**Can you chip in a donation of $5? With hundreds of people joining you, that $5 will add up fast and we’ll hit our goals in no time.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-dec23.OiwIwT&refcode=em231214-1-f&t=1&akid=5674%2E6688874%2E06DAV9)

\- Mark

My name is Pat Harrigan. You don't know me, but I'm a Green Beret veteran from North Carolina. I graduated from West Point, and I served 18 months in combat.

After that, my wife and I started a firearm parts company from our double-wide trailer - and grew it to become a successful, job-creating business. And most important of all, I'm the dad of two beautiful girls.

**I 'm also a GOP candidate in the MUST WIN race in NC-10, a district that Congressman McHenrys just retired from and one that WILL decide who controls Washington.**

Getting the Affordable Care Act done For The People was a singular honor for me as Speaker of the House.

Without one Republican vote, courageous Democrats expanded affordable health care coverage to tens of millions more Americans; improved the rights of __everyone__ with health insurance; guaranteed protections from denials of care for __150 million__ Americans with preexisting medical conditions and banned annual and lifetime limits on health care.
So let’s be clear about what it would mean if Trump “terminates” this legislation:
* **40 million Americans** would be kicked off their health care immediately
* **150 million with pre-existing conditions** could be denied coverage.
* Families would face **lifetime limits** on care once again.
* **Young adults** would no longer be able to stay on family plans until age 26.
* Access to **mental health care** would be decimated.
* **Being a woman would be a pre-existing condition** , once again.

_**Not on our watch!**_

These aren’t just numbers. Every denial of care is a physical, emotional and financial tragedy for the patient and their family.
Democrats refuse to go back to the days of **greedy insurance companies** denying care -- and life, itself -- to patients.
**We will protect patients’ rights and strengthen and expand -- not terminate -- the Affordable Care Act!**

One of my opponents in the Race to Replace Perry recently garnered news with the announcement that she is using AI to have “real conversations” with people. I always think of “real conversations” as being between "real people” with “real intelligence,” not artificial anything. But let’s explore AI a little further.

For example, one of my supporters submitted the following query to ChatGPT:

_“I want you to imagine a Democratic candidate for Congress with the strongest possible chance to defeat Rep. Scott Perry, 10th PA Congressional District. Take into account both the weaknesses and strengths of Representative Perry. Describe this imaginary candidate's political strengths.”_

See if the top three AI responses remind you of anyone –

__Local Roots and Community Engagement__
* _The candidate should have strong ties to the district, perhaps being a long-time resident or having a history of community involvement._
* _Demonstrated commitment to local issues and a deep understanding of the concerns and needs of the district's residents._

__Pragmatic Solutions__
* _Emphasize a pragmatic and bipartisan approach to problem-solving, appealing to voters who value practical solutions over strict ideological stances._
* _Ability to work across party lines to address the unique challenges facing the district._

__Military or Law Enforcement Background__
* _Highlight a military or law enforcement background, appealing to the district's significant population with ties to the military or law enforcement._
* _Emphasize a commitment to national security and public safety._

I look forward to having a real conversation with you in the months and years to come.

clean_body: | One of my opponents in the Race to Replace Perry recently garnered news with the announcement that she is using AI to have “real conversations” with people. I always think of “real conversations” as being between "real people” with “real intelligence,” not artificial anything. But let’s explore AI a little further. For example, one of my supporters submitted the following query to ChatGPT: “I want you to imagine a Democratic candidate for Congress with the strongest possible chance to defeat Rep. Scott Perry, 10th PA Congressional District. Take into account both the weaknesses and strengths of Representative Perry. Describe this imaginary candidate's political strengths.” See if the top three AI responses remind you of anyone – Local Roots and Community Engagement The candidate should have strong ties to the district, perhaps being a long-time resident or having a history of community involvement. Demonstrated commitment to local issues and a deep understanding of the concerns and needs of the district's residents. Pragmatic Solutions Emphasize a pragmatic and bipartisan approach to problem-solving, appealing to voters who value practical solutions over strict ideological stances. Ability to work across party lines to address the unique challenges facing the district. Military or Law Enforcement Background Highlight a military or law enforcement background, appealing to the district's significant population with ties to the military or law enforcement. Emphasize a commitment to national security and public safety. I look forward to having a real conversation with you in the months and years to come. Thanks as always for your help in the Race to Replace. More to come, Rick | | = | | | | | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Friends of Rick Coplen | =
